readings.title: 45. Farewell to the Month of Ramadan
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَرْغَبُ فِي الْجَزَاءِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma yā man lā yarghabu fīl-jazāʾi
records.english_text: O God, O He who desires no repayment!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ يَنْدَمُ عَلَى الْعَطَآءِ،
records.transliteration: walā yandamu ʿalā al-ʿaṭāʾ
records.english_text: O He who shows no remorse at bestowal!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُكَافِئُ عَبْدَهُ عَلَى السَّوآءِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā yukāfiʾu ʿabdahu ʿalā al-sawāʾi
records.english_text: O He who rewards not His servant tit for tat!

records.arabic_text: مِنَّتُكَ ابْتِدَاءٌ، وَعَفْوُكَ تَفَضُّلٌ، وَعُقُوبَتُكَ عَـدْلٌ، وَقَضَاؤُكَ خِيَرَةٌ،
records.transliteration: min natuka ibtidā'un, wa'afwuka tafadhdhulun waʿuqūbatuka ʿadlun, waqaḍāʾuka khīyaratun
records.english_text: Thy kindness is a new beginning, Thy pardon gratuitous bounty, Thy punishment justice, Thy decree a choice for the best!

records.arabic_text: إنْ أَعْطَيْتَ لَمْ تَشُبْ عَطَآءَكَ بِمَنٍّ، وَإنْ مَنَعْتَ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَنْعُكَ تَعَدِّيا
records.transliteration: in ʾin ʾaʿṭayta lam tashub ʿaṭāʾaka bimannin wa in manʿta lam yakun manaʿuka taʿaddin
records.english_text: If Thou bestowest, Thou stainest not Thy bestowal with obligation, and if Thou withholdest, Thou withholdest not in transgression.

records.arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ مَنْ شَكَرَكَ وَأَنْتَ أَلْهَمْتَهُ شُكْرَكَ،
records.transliteration: tashkur man shakaraka wa anta alhamtahu shukraka
records.english_text: Thou showest gratitude to him who thanks Thee, while Thou hast inspired him to thank Thee.

records.arabic_text: وَتُكَافِئُ مَنْ حَمِدَكَ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّمْتَهُ حَمْدَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa tukāfiʾu man ḥamidak wa anta ʿallamtahu ḥamdak
records.english_text: Thou rewardest him who praises Thee, while though Thou hast taught him Thy praise.

records.arabic_text: تَسْتُرُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ فَضَحْتَهُ وَتَجُودُ عَلَى مَنْ لَوْ شِئْتَ مَنَعْتَهُ،
records.transliteration: tasturu ʿala man law shi'ta faḍaḥtahu wa tajūdu ʿalā man law shiʾta manʿtahu
records.english_text: Thou coverest him whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst expose, and Thou art generous toward him from whom, if Thou willed, Thou wouldst withhold.

records.arabic_text: وَكِلاَهُمَا أَهْلٌ مِنْكَ لِلْفَضِيحَةِ وَالْمَنْعِ، غَيْرَ أَنَّكَ بَنَيْتَ أَفْعَالَكَ عَلَى التَّفَضُّلِ، وَأَجْرَيْتَ قُدْرَتَكَ عَلَى التَّجَاوُزِ، وَتَلَقَّيْتَ مَنْ عَصَاكَ بِالحِلْمِ،
records.transliteration: wa-kilāhumā ahlu minka li-lfadhihah wa-lman'ِ ġayra annaka banayta afʿālaka ʿalā tafadḍul waʾajrayta qudrataka ʿalā al-tajāwuzi wa talqaayta man ʿasāka bilḥilm
records.english_text: Both are worthy of Thy exposure and withholding, but Thou hast founded Thy acts upon gratuitous bounty, channelled Thy power into forbearance, received him who disobeyed Thee with clemency,

records.arabic_text: وَأمْهَلْتَ مَنْ قَصَدَ لِنَفْسِهِ بِالظُّلْمِ
records.transliteration: wa-amhaltu man qasada linafsihi bilẓulm
records.english_text: and disregarded him who intended wrongdoing against himself.

records.arabic_text: تَسْتَنْظِرُهُمْ بِأناتِكَ إلى الإنَابَةِ وَتَتْرُكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُمْ إلَى التَّوْبَةِ لِكَيْلاَ يَهْلِكَ عَلَيْكَ هَالِكُهُمْ، وَلا يَشْقَى بِنِعْمَتِكَ شَقِيُّهُمْ إلاَّ عَنْ طُولِ الإِعْذَارِ إلَيْهِ،
records.transliteration: tastanẓiruhum bi'anatika ila al-inabati wa tatruku mu'ajalatahum ila al-tawba li-kayla yahlika ʿalayka haalikuhum walā yashqā binʿamati-ka shaqīyuhum illa ʿan ṭūl al-iʿḏār ilayhi
records.english_text: Thou awaitest their turning back without haste and refrainest from rushing them toward repentance, so that the perisher among them may not perish because of Thee and the wretched may not be wretched through Thy favour, but only after Thy prolonged excusing him

records.arabic_text: وَبَعْدَ تَرَادُفِ الْحُجَّةِ عَلَيْهِ كَرَماً مِنْ عَفْوِكَ يَا كَرِيْمُ، وَعَائِدَةً مِنْ عَطْفِكَ يَا حَلِيمُ.
records.transliteration: wa baʿda tarādufi al-ḥujjati ʿalayhi karāman min ʿafwikā yā karīm waʿāʾidatan min ʿatfika yā ḥalīm
records.english_text: and successive arguments against him, as an act of generosity through Thy pardon, O Generous, and an act of kindliness through Thy tenderness, O Clement!

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِيْ فَتَحْتَ لِعِبَادِكَ بَاباً إلَى عَفْوِكَ وَسَمَّيْتَهُ التَّوْبَـةَ،
records.transliteration: anta alladhī fataḥta li-ʿibādika bāban 'ilā 'afwik wa sammaytahu attawbah'
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast opened for Thy servants a door to Thy pardon, which Thou hast named 'repentance'.

records.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَ عَلَى ذلِكَ البَابِ دَلِيلاً مِنْ وَحْيِكَ لِئَلاَّ يَضِلُّوا عَنْهُ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ : (تُوبُوا إلَى الله تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً عَسَى رَبُّكُمْ أَنْ يُكَفِّـرَ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ
records.transliteration: wa jaʿalt ʿalā dhālika al-bābi dalīlan min wahyika liʾallā yaḍillū ʿanhū faqultu tabāraka asmuka tuubuu ilaa allahi tawbatan nasuuhan 'asaa rabbukum 'an yukaffira 'ankum sayyiatikum wa yudkhilakum
records.english_text: Thou hast placed upon that door a pointer from Thy revelation, lest they stray from it: Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name), "Repent toward God with unswerving repentance! It may be that Thy Lord will acquit of your evil deeds and will admit you into

records.arabic_text: جَنَّات تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأنْهَارُ يَوْمَ لاَ يُخْزِي اللهُ النَّبِيَّ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ نُورُهُمْ يَسْعَى بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَانِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا
records.transliteration: jannāt tajrī min taḥtiha al-anhār yawma lā yukhzī allāhu an-nabiyّa wa-al-latheena amanoo ma'ahu nooruhum yas'aa bayna aydeehim wabi-a'manihim yaqūlūna rabbanā atmim lanā nūranā waghfir lanā
records.english_text: gardens beneath which rivers flow, upon the day when God will not degrade the Prophet and those who have faith along with him, their light running before them and on their right hands, and they say: 'Our Lord, complete for us our light, and forgive us!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ)
records.transliteration: 'innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadeerun
records.english_text: Surely Thou art powerful over everything" (66:8).

records.arabic_text: فَمَا عُذْرُ مَنْ أَغْفَلَ دُخُولَ ذلِكَ الْمَنْزِلِ بَعْدَ فَتْحِ الْبَابِ وَإقَامَةِ الدَّلِيْلِ،
records.transliteration: fa mā ʿudhr man aghfala dukhūla dhālika al-manzil baʿda fatḥi al-bābi wa iqāmati al-dalīl
records.english_text: What is the excuse of him who remains heedless of entering that house after the opening of the door and the setting up of the pointer?

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي زِدْتَ فِي السَّوْمِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ لِعِبَادِكَ تُرِيدُ رِبْحَهُمْ فِي مُتَاجَرَتِهِمْ لَكَ، وَفَوْزَهُمْ بِالْوِفَادَةِ عَلَيْكَ وَالزِّيادَةِ مِنْكَ فَقُلْتَ تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ:
records.transliteration: wa anta alladhi zidta fi al-sawmi ʿala nafsika li ʿibadik turīdu ribhahum fī mutājaratihim laka wa fawzahum bilwifadati ʿalayka walziyadati minka faqulta tabāraka asmuka wa taʿālayta:
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast raised the price against Thyself to the advantage of Thy servants, desiring their profit in their trade with Thee, their triumph through reaching Thee, and their increase on account of Thee, for Thou hast said (blessed is Thy Name and high art Thou exalted),

records.arabic_text: (مَنْ جَاءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا وَمَنْ جَاءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلاَ يُجْزى إلاّ مِثْلَهَا)
records.transliteration: man jaa'a bil-ḥasanati falahu ʿashru ʾamthālihā wa-man jaa'a bil-sayyiati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa
records.english_text: "Whoso brings a good deed shall have ten the like of it, and whoso brings an evil deed shall only be recompensed the like of it" (6:160).

records.arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (مَثَلُ الَّذِينَ يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ الله كَمَثَلِ حَبَّة أَنْبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَة مَائَةُ حَبَّة
records.transliteration: waqulta: (mathalu alladheena yunfiqoona amwalahum fi sabili allahi kama mathali habbati) 'anbatat sab'a sanabil fi kulli sunbulah mi'atu habbah
records.english_text: Thou hast said, "The likeness of those who expend their wealth in the way of God is as the likeness of a grain of corn that sprouts seven ears, in every ear a hundred grains;

records.arabic_text: وَالله يُضَاعِفُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ)
records.transliteration: wa-allahu yuda'ifu liman yasha'u
records.english_text: so God multiplies unto whom He wills" (2:261).

records.arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يُقْرِضُ الله قَرْضاً حَسَنَاً فَيُضَاعِفَهُ لَهُ أضْعَافاً كَثِيرَةً)
records.transliteration: wa qult: "man dha alladhi yuqridhullāh qardhan hasanā" fayuḍāʿifahu lahu aḍʿāfān kathīrah
records.english_text: Thou hast said, "Who is he that will lend to God a good loan, and He will multiply it for him manifold" (2:245)?

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَنْزَلْتَ مِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ فِي الْقُرْآنِ مِنْ تَضَاعِيفِ الْحَسَنَاتِ،
records.transliteration: wama anzalta min nadhāʾirihinna fīl-qur'āni min taḍāʿīfi al-ḥasanāt
records.english_text: And Thou hast sent down in the Qur'an similar verses on the multiplying of good deeds.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي دَلَلْتَهُمْ بِقَوْلِكَ مِنْ غَيْبِكَ وَتَرْغِيْبِكَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَظُّهُمْ عَلَى مَا لَوْ سَتَرْتَهُ عَنْهُمْ لَمْ تُدْرِكْهُ أَبْصَارُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَعِـهِ أَسْمَاعُهُمْ وَلَمْ تَلْحَقْـهُ أَوْهَامُهُمْ
records.transliteration: wa anta allaḏī dalaltahum biqawlika min ghaybika wa tarġībika alladhī fīhi ḥaẓẓuhum ʿalā mā law satartahu ʿanhum lam tudrikhu abṣāruhum wa lam taʿihi asmāʾuhum wa lam talhaqhu aw'hamuhum
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast pointed them through Thy speech from Thy Unseen and Thy encouragement in which lies their good fortune toward that which - hadst Thou covered it from them their eyes would not have perceived, their ears would not have heard, and their imaginations would not have grasped,

records.arabic_text: فَقُلْتَ: (اذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِيْ وَلا تَكْفُرُونِ)
records.transliteration: faqultu: (udhkuruni adhkurkum wa ashkuru li wa la takfuruni)
records.english_text: for Thou hast said, "Remember Me and I will remember you be thankful to Me, and be you not thankless towards Me" (2:152)!

records.arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ: (لَئِنْ شَكَـرْتُمْ لازِيدَنَّكمْ وَلَئِنْ كَفَـرْتُمْ إنَّ عَذابِيْ لَشَدِيدٌ)
records.transliteration: wa qulta: "la'in shakartum lazidannakum." wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabī lashadīd
records.english_text: Thou hast said, "If you are thankful, surely I will increase you, but if you are thankless, My chastisement is surely terrible" (14:7);

records.arabic_text: وَقُلْتَ : (ادْعُونِيْ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إنَّ الَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِي سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ)
records.transliteration: wa qulta: (idʿūnī astajib lakum) inna allatheena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibadati sayadkhulun jahannama dakhireen
records.english_text: And Thou hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you, surely those who wax too proud to worship Me shall enter Gehenna utterly abject" (40:60).

records.arabic_text: فَسَمَّيْتَ دُعَاءَكَ عِبَادَةً، وَتَرْكَهُ اسْتِكْبَاراً، وَتَوَعَّدْتَ عَلَى تَرْكِهِ دُخُولَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ،
records.transliteration: fa-sammayta du'āka ʿibādah, wa-tarkahu istikbāran wa tawaʿaddta ʿalā tarkih dukhūl al-jahannama dākhilīna
records.english_text: Hence Thou hast named supplicating Thee 'worship' and refraining from it 'waxing proud', and Thou hast threatened that the refraining from it would yield entrance into Gehenna in utter abjection.

records.arabic_text: فَذَكَرُوكَ بِمَنِّكَ وَشَكَرُوكَ بِفَضْلِكَ، وَدَعَوْكَ بِأَمْرِكَ، وَتَصَدَّقُوا لَكَ طَلَباً لِمَزِيدِكَ،
records.transliteration: faḏakaruka bimannika wa shakaruka bifadlik wa daʿawka bi-amrika wa taṣaddaqū lak(a) ṭalaban limazīdik(a)
records.english_text: So they remember Thee for Thy kindness, they thank Thee for Thy bounty, they supplicate Thee by Thy command, and they donate for Thee in order to seek Thy increase;

records.arabic_text: وَفِيهَا كَانَتْ نَجَاتُهُمْ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ، وَفَوْزُهُمْ بِرِضَاكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-fiha kānat najātuhum min ghadabika wa fawzuhum bi-riḍāka
records.english_text: in all this lies their deliverance from Thy wrath and their triumph through Thy good pleasure.

records.arabic_text: وَلَوْ دَلَّ مَخْلُوقٌ مَخْلُوقاً مِنْ نَفْسِهِ عَلَى مِثْلِ الَّذِيْ دَلَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عِبَادَكَ مِنْكَ كَانَ مَوْصُوْفَاً بالإحْسَان وَمَنْعُوتاً بِالامْتِثَال ومحمُوداً بكلِّ لِسَان،
records.transliteration: wa law dallā makhluqun makhluqan min nafsihi ʿalā mithli allathī dalaltā ʿalayhi ʿibādaka minka kāna mawṣūfan bil-iḥsān wa man'ūtan bil-imitthāl wa maḥmūdan bikulli lisān
records.english_text: Were any creature himself to direct another creature to the like of that to which Thou Thyself hast directed Thy servants, he would be described by beneficence, qualified by kindness, and praised by every tongue.

records.arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ مَا وُجِدَ فِي حَمْدِكَ مَذْهَبٌ، وَمَا بَقِيَ لِلْحَمْدِ لَفْظٌ تُحْمَدُ بِهِ وَمَعْنىً يَنْصَرفُ إلَيْهِ
records.transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu mā wujida fī ḥamdika maḏhabun wamā baqiya lil-ḥamdi lafẓun tuḥmadu bihī wamaʿnan yanṣarifu ilayhī
records.english_text: So to Thee belongs praise as long as there is found a way to praise Thee and as long as there remains for praising words by which Thou may be praised and meanings which may be spent in praise!

records.arabic_text: يَـا مَنْ تَحَمَّدَ إلَى عِبَـادِهِ بِالإِحْسَـانِ وَالْفَضْل، وَغَمَرَهُمْ بِالْمَنِّ وَالطَّوْلِ،
records.transliteration: yā man taḥammada ilā ʿibādih bi-l-'iḥsāni wa-l-faḍl wa ghamarahum bil manni wattaawli
records.english_text: O He who shows Himself praiseworthy to His servants through beneficence and bounty, flooding them with kindness and graciousness!

records.arabic_text: مَا أَفْشَى فِيْنَا نِعْمَتَكَ وَأَسْبَغَ عَلَيْنَا مِنَّتَكَ، وَأَخَصَّنَا بِبِرِّكَ
records.transliteration: mā afshā fīnā niʿmatka wa asbağa ʿalaynā minnatka wa-akhassana bi-birrika
records.english_text: How much Thy favour has been spread about among us, Thy kindness lavished upon us, and Thy goodness singled out for us!

records.arabic_text: هَدْيَتَنَا لِدِيْنِكَ الَّـذِي اصْطَفَيْتَ، وَمِلَّتِـكَ الَّتِي ارْتَضَيْتَ، وَسَبِيلِكَ الَّذِي سَهَّلْتَ، وَبَصَّرْتَنَا الزُّلْفَةَ لَدَيْكَ وَالوُصُولَ إلَى كَـرَامَتِكَ.
records.transliteration: hadīyatunā li-dīnika alladhī iṣtafayta wa millatika allati artadayta wa sabeelika alladhee sahhalt wa baṣṣartanā aż-żulfa taʿaynak wal-wuṣūla ilā karamatik
records.english_text: Thou hast guided us to Thy religion which Thou hast chosen, Thy creed with which Thou art pleased, and Thy path which Thou hast made smooth, and Thou hast shown us proximity to Thee and arrival at Thy generosity!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنْتَ جَعَلْتَ مِنْ صَفَـايَـا تِلْكَ الْوَظَائِفِ وَخَصَائِصِ تِلْكَ الْفُرُوضِ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُ مِنْ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ، وَتَخَيَّرْتَهُ مِن جَمِيعِ الأزْمِنَةِ وَالدُّهُورِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa anta jaʿaltamin safāyā tilka alwaẓāʾif wa khassā'is tilka al-furūḍ shahr ramadan al-ladhi ikhtassahu min sa'ir al-shuhur wa-takhayyartahu min jami' al-azminati wa ad-duhur
records.english_text: O God, Thou hast appointed among the choicest of those duties and the most special of those obligations the month of Ramadan, which Thou hast singled out from other months, chosen from among all periods and eras,

records.arabic_text: وَآثَرْتَهُ عَلَى كُلِّ أَوْقَاتِ السَّنَةِ بِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ وَالنُّورِ، وَضَاعَفْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الإيْمَانِ، وَفَرَضْتَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الصِّيَامِ،
records.transliteration: wa ʾathartahu ʿalaa kulli awqaatis-sannah bimā anzalta fīhi min al-qur'āni wa al-nūr waḍāʿafta fīhi min al-īmāni wa faraḍta fīhi mina al-ṣiyām
records.english_text: and preferred over all times of the year through the Qur'an and the Light which Thou sent down within it, the faith which Thou multiplied by means of it, the fasting which Thou obligated therein,

records.arabic_text: وَرَغَّبْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ القِيَامِ، وَأَجْلَلْتَ فِيهِ مِنْ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر،
records.transliteration: wa-raghabta fiihi min al-qiyam wa-ajlaltu fīhi min laylati al-qadr al-latī hiya khayrun min alfi shahr
records.english_text: the standing in prayer which Thou encouraged at its time, and the Night of Decree which Thou magnified therein, the night which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3).

records.arabic_text: ثُمَّ آثَرْتَنَا بِهِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الأُمَمِ وَاصْطَفَيْتَنَا بِفَضْلِهِ دُوْنَ أَهْلِ الْمِلَلِ،
records.transliteration: thumma athartana bihi 'ala sa'iri al-umam wa-aṣṭafaytanā bifadlihi dūna ahli al-milal
records.english_text: Through it Thou hast preferred us over the other communities and through its excellence Thou hast chosen us to the exclusion of the people of the creeds.

records.arabic_text: فَصُمْنَا بِأَمْرِكَ نَهَارَهُ، وَقُمْنَا بِعَوْنِكَ لَيْلَهُ مُتَعَرِّضِينَ بِصِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ لِمَا عَرَّضْتَنَا لَهُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ، وَتَسَبَّبْنَا إلَيْـهِ مِنْ مَثُوبَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: faṣumna biamrika nahārahu wa qumnā biʿawnika laylahu mutʿarraḍīna bi-ṣiyāmihi wa qiyāmihi limā ʿarraḍtanā lahū min raḥmatika wa tasabbabnā ilayhi min mathūbatika
records.english_text: We fasted by Thy command in its daylight, we stood in prayer with Thy help in its night, presenting ourselves by its fasting and its standing to the mercy which Thou hast held up before us, and we found through it the means to Thy reward.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الْمَليءُ بِمَا رُغِبَ فِيهِ إلَيْكَ، الْجَوَادُ بِمـا سُئِلْتَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، الْقَـرِيبُ إلَى مَنْ حَـاوَلَ قُرْبَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-anta al-malīʾu bimā rughiba fīhi ilayka al-jawādu bimā suʾilta min faḍlika al-qarībū ʾilā man ḥāwala qurbaka
records.english_text: And Thou art full of what is sought from Thee, munificent with what is asked of Thy bounty, and near to him who strives for Thy nearness.

records.arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَقَامَ فِينَا هَذَا الشَّهْرُ مَقَامَ حَمْد وَصَحِبَنَا صُحْبَةَ مَبْرُور، وَأَرْبَحَنَا أَفْضَلَ أَرْبَاحِ الْعَالَمِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa qad aqama feenaa haadha ash-shahr maqaam hamd waṣaḥibana ṣuḥbata mabrūr wa-arbaḥanā afḍala arbaḥi al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: This month stood among us in a standing place of praise, accompanied us with the companionship of one approved, and profited us with the most excellent profit of the world's creatures.

records.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَدْ فَارَقَنَا عِنْدَ تَمَامِ وَقْتِهِ وَانْقِطَاعِ مُدَّتِهِ وَوَفَاءِ عَدَدِهِ،
records.transliteration: thumma qad faraqnaa ʿinda tamami waqtihii wa anqitaai muddatihii wa wafaai ʿadadihii
records.english_text: Then it parted from us at the completion of its time, the end of its term, and the fulfilment of its number.

records.arabic_text: فَنَحْنُ مُوَدِّعُوهُ وِدَاعَ مَنْ عَزَّ فِرَاقُهُ عَلَيْنَا وَغَمَّنَا وَأَوْحَشَنَا انْصِرَافُهُ عَنَّا وَلَزِمَنَا لَهُ الذِّمَامُ الْمَحْفُوظُ، وَالْحُرْمَةُ الْمَرْعِيَّةُ، وَالْحَقُّ الْمَقْضِيُّ،
records.transliteration: fanahnu muwaddiʿūhu widāʿa man ʿazza firāquhu ʿalaynā wa ghammanna wa awhashna insiraafuhu anna walazimana lahu al dhimamu al mahfuzhu wal-ḥurmatu-l-marʿiyyatu, wal-ḥaqqul-maqḍiyyu
records.english_text: So we bid farewell to it with the farewell of one whose parting pains us, whose leaving fills us with gloom and loneliness, and to whom we have come to owe a safeguarded claim, an observed inviolability, and a discharged right.

records.arabic_text: فَنَحْنُ قَائِلُونَ: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا شَهْرَ اللهِ الأكْبَرَ، وَيَا عِيْدَ أَوْلِيَائِهِ.
records.transliteration: fa-nahnu qa'iloon: assalamu 'alayka yā shahr allāhi l-akbar, wa yā ʿīda awliyāʾihi
records.english_text: We say: Peace be upon thee, O greatest month of God! O festival of His friends!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَـا أكْرَمَ مَصْحُـوب مِنَ الأوْقَاتِ،
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka yā akram maṣḥūb min al-awqāt
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, O most noble of accompanying times!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا خَيْرَ شَهْر فِي الأيَّامِ وَالسَّاعَاتِ.
records.transliteration: wayā khayra shahr fī al-ʾayyām wa al-sāʿāt
records.english_text: O best of months in days and hours!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر قَرُبَتْ فِيهِ الآمالُ وَنُشِرَتْ فِيهِ الأَعْمَالُ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min shahr qarubat fīhi al-āmāl wa nushirat fihi al-aʿmāl
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, month in which expectations come near and good works are scattered about!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَرِين جَلَّ قَدْرُهُ مَوْجُوداً، وَأَفْجَعَ فَقْدُهُ مَفْقُوداً، وَمَرْجُوٍّ آلَمَ فِرَاقُهُ.
records.transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka min qarīn jalla qadruhu mawjūdā wa'afja'a faqduhu mafqoodan, wa marjuwwin alama firaaquhu
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, comrade who is great in worth when found and who torments through absence when lost, anticipated friend whose parting gives pain!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَلِيف آنَسَ مُقْبِلاً فَسَرَّ وَأَوْحَشَ مُنْقَضِياً فَمَضَّ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min ʾalīf ʾānsa muqbilan fasarra wa-awḥaša munqaḍiyān famaḍḍa
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, familiar who brought comfort in coming, thus making happy, who left loneliness in going, thus giving anguish!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مُجَاوِر رَقَّتْ فِيهِ الْقُلُوبُ، وَقَلَّتْ فِيهِ الذُّنُوبُ.
records.transliteration: as-salāmu ʿalayka min mujāwir raqqat fīhi al-qulūbu, wa qallat fīhi al-dhunūbu
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, neighbour in whom hearts became tender and sins became few!

records.arabic_text: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ نَاصِر أَعَانَ عَلَى الشَّيْطَانِ وَصَاحِب سَهَّلَ سُبُلَ الإحْسَانِ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min nāṣir aʿāna ʿalā al-shayṭān wa ṣāḥib sahhala subul al-iḥsān
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, helper who aided against Satan, companion who made easy the paths of good-doing!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا أكْثَرَ عُتَقَاءَ اللهِ فِيكَ
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā akthara ʿutāqāʾa allāhi fīka
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - How many became freedmen of God within thee!

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَسْعَدَ مَنْ رَعَى حُرْمَتَكَ بكَ!.
records.transliteration: wa mā asʿada man raʿā ḥurmataka bika!
records.english_text: How happy those who observed the respect due to thee!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَمْحَاكَ لِلذُّنُوبِ،
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā kāna amḥāka lil-dhunūb
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - How many the sins thou erased!

records.arabic_text: وَأَسْتَرَكَ لأَِنْوَاعِ الْعُيُوبِ!
records.transliteration: wa astarak li-anwāʿi al-ʿuyūb!
records.english_text: How many the kinds of faults thou covered over!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مَا كَانَ أَطْوَلَكَ عَلَى الْمُجْرِمِينَ،
records.transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka mā kāna aṭwalaka ʿalā al-mujrimīn
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - How drawn out wert thou for the sinners!

records.arabic_text: وَأَهْيَبَكَ فِي صُدُورِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ!
records.transliteration: wa 'ahyabaka fi suduri al-mu'mineen!
records.english_text: How awesome wert thou in the hearts of the faithful!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر لا تُنَافِسُهُ الأيَّامُ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min shahrin lā tunāfisu-hu al-ayyāmu
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, month with which no days compete!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ شَهْر هُوَ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْر سَلاَمٌ.
records.transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka min shahr huwa min kulli amrin salam.
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, month which is peace in all affairs!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ كَرِيهِ الْمُصَاحَبَةِ وَلاَ ذَمِيمِ الْمُلاَبَسَةِ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka ghayra karīhi al-muṣāḥabah walā ẓamīm al-mulābasah
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, thou whose companionship is not disliked, thou whose friendly mixing is not blamed!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمَا وَفَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا بِالْبَرَكَاتِ، وَغَسَلْتَ عَنَّا دَنَسَ الْخَطِيئاتِ.
records.transliteration: assalamu ʿalayka kama wafadta ʿalayna bil-barakat wa ghasaltu `annā danasa al-khaṭī'āt
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, just as thou hast entered upon us with blessings and cleansed us of the defilement of offenses!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّع بَرَماً وَلاَ مَتْرُوك صِيَامُهُ سَأَماً.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka ghayra muwaddaʿa, baraman walā matrūk ṣiyāmuhu s'aman
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - Thou art not bid farewell in annoyance nor is thy fasting left in weariness!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ مَطْلُوبِ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهِ وَمَحْزُون عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ فَوْتِهِ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka min maṭlūbi qabla waqtih wa maḥzūn ʿalayhi qabla fawtihi
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee, object of seeking before thy time, object of sorrow before thy passing!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ كَمْ مِنْ سُوء صُرِفَ بِكَ عَنَّا
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka kam min sūʾ ṣurifa bika ʿannā
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - How much evil was turned away from us through thee!

records.arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ خَيْر أُفِيضَ بِكَ عَلَيْنَا.
records.transliteration: wa kam min khayrin ufiḍa bi-ka ʿalayna
records.english_text: How much good flowed upon us because of thee!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْـكَ وَعَلَى لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ الَّتِي هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ شَهْر.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka wa ʿalā laylat al-qadr al-latī hiya khayrun min alfi shahr
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee and upon the Night of Decree which is "better than a thousand months" (97:3)!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ما كَانَ أَحْرَصَنَا بِالأمْسِ عَلَيْكَ
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka mā kāna ahrasanā bil-amsi ʿalayka
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee - How much we craved thee yesterday!

records.arabic_text: وَأَشَدَّ شَوْقَنَا غَدَاً إلَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: wa ashadda shawqana ghadan ilayka
records.english_text: How intensely we shall yearn for thee tomorrow!

records.arabic_text: أَلسَلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ الَّذِي حُرِمْنَاهُ ، وَعَلَى مَاض مِنْ بَرَكَاتِكَ سُلِبْنَاهُ.
records.transliteration: al-salāmu ʿalayka wa ʿalā faḍlika alladhī ḥurimnāhu wa ʿalā māḍin min barakātika sulibnāhu
records.english_text: Peace be upon thee and upon thy bounty which has now been made unlawful to us and upon thy blessings gone by which have now been stripped away from us!

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّا أَهْلُ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ الِّذِي شَرَّفْتَنَا بِهِ وَوَفّقتَنَا بِمَنِّكَ لَهُ حِينَ جَهِلَ الاَشْقِيَا وَقْتَهُُ
records.transliteration: allāhumma innā ahlū hādha al-shahr alladhī sharraftanā bihi wa waffaqatana bimannika lahu heena jahila al-ashqiya waqtahu
records.english_text: O God, we are the people of this month. Through it Thou hast ennobled us and given us success because of Thy kindness, while the wretched are ignorant of its time.

records.arabic_text: وَحُرِمُوا لِشَقَائِهِم فَضْلَهُ،
records.transliteration: wa ḥurimū li-shaqāʾihim faḍlahu
records.english_text: Made unlawful to them is its bounty because of their wretchedness.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ وَلِيُّ مَا اثَرْتَنَا بِهِ مِنْ مَعْرِفَتِهِ، وَهَدَيْتَنَا مِنْ سُنَّتِهِ،
records.transliteration: 'anta waliyyu ma athartana bihi min ma'rifatihi wahadaytanā min sunnatihi
records.english_text: Thou art the patron of the knowledge of it by which Thou hast preferred us, and its prescribed practices to which Thou hast guided us.

records.arabic_text: وَقَدْ تَوَلَّيْنَا بِتَوْفِيقِكَ صِيَامَهُ وَقِيَامَهُ عَلى تَقْصِير، وَأَدَّيْنَا فِيهِ قَلِيلاً مِنْ كَثِيـر.
records.transliteration: waqad tawallayna bi tawfiqika ṣiyāmahu wa qiyamahu ʿalā taqṣīr wa addaynā fīhi qalīlan min kathīr
records.english_text: We have undertaken, through Thy giving success, its fasting and its standing in prayer, but with shortcomings, and we have performed little of much.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَلَكَ الْحمدُ إقْـرَاراً بِـالإسَاءَةَ وَاعْتِرَافاً بِالإضَاعَةِ، وَلَك مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا عَقْدُ النَّدَمِ، وَمِنْ أَلْسِنَتِنَا صِدْقُ الاعْتِذَارِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma falaka al-ḥamdu iq'rāran bil-issā'a waʿtirāfan bil-iḍāʿah, wa lak min qulūbinā ʿaqdu al-nadami wa min al-sinatina sidqu al-iʿtizār
records.english_text: O God, so to Thee belongs praise, in admission of evil doing and confession of negligence, and to Thee belongs remorse firmly knitted in our hearts and seeking of pardon sincerely uttered by our tongues.

records.arabic_text: فَاْجُرْنَا عَلَى مَا أَصَابَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ التَّفْرِيطِ أَجْرَاً نَسْتَدْركُ بِهِ الْفَضْلَ الْمَرْغُوبَ فِيهِ، وَنَعْتَاضُ بِهِ مِنْ أَنْوَاعِ الذُّخْرِ الْمَحْرُوصِ عَلَيْهِ ،
records.transliteration: fajurna ʿalā mā aṣābanā fīhi mina al-tafṛiṭi ajrān nastadrik bih al-faḍl al-marghūb fīh wa-naʿtaẓu bihi min anwāʿi al-ẓukhri al-maḥruṣi ʿalayhi
records.english_text: Reward us, in spite of the neglect that befell us in this month, with a reward through which we may reach the bounty desired from it and win the varieties of its craved stores!

records.arabic_text: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا عُذْرَكَ عَلَى مَا قَصَّرْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ حَقِّكَ، وَابْلُغْ بِأَعْمَارِنَا مَا بَيْنَ أَيْديْنَا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُقْبِلِ،
records.transliteration: waʾawjib lana ʿudhraka ʿala ma qassarnā fīhi min ḥaqqika wa-ablugh bi-aʿmārinā mā bayna ʾaydīnā min shahr ramadān al-muqbil
records.english_text: Make incumbent upon us Thy pardon for our falling short of Thy right in this month and make our lives which lie before us reach the coming month of Ramadan!

records.arabic_text: فَإذَا بَلَّغْتَنَاهُ فَأَعِنَّا عَلَى تَنَاوُلِ مَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ مِنَ الْعِبَادَةِ وَأَدِّنَا إلَى الْقِيَامِ بِمَا يَسْتَحِقُّهُ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ وَأجْرِ لنا مِنْ صَالِحِ العَمَلِ
records.transliteration: fa-idha ballaghtanāhu fa-aʿinnā ʿalā tanāwuli mā anta ahluhu min al-ʿibādah wa-addinā ilā al-qiyāmi bimā yastahiqquhu mina al-ṭāʿati wa ajri lana min salihi al'amal
records.english_text: Once Thou hast made us reach it, help us perform the worship of which Thou art worthy, cause us to undertake the obedience which Thou deservest, and grant us righteous works

records.arabic_text: مَا يَكون دَرَكاً لِحَقِّكَ فِي الشَّهْرَيْنِ مِنْ شُهُورِ الدَّهْرِ.
records.transliteration: mā yakūnu darakan li-ḥaqqika fī ash-shahrayni min shuhūri ad-dahr
records.english_text: that we may fulfil Thy right in these two months of the months of time.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَمَا أَلْمَمْنَا بِهِ فِي شَهْرِنَا هَذَا مِنْ لَمَم أَوْ إثْم، أَوْ وَاقَعْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ ذَنْبِ وَاكْتَسَبْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَة عَلَى تَعَمُّد مِنَّا أو عَلى نِسيانٍ ظَلَمنا فيه أنفُسَنا أَوِ انْتَهَكْنَا بِهِ حُرْمَةً مِنْ غَيْرِنَا فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاسْتُرْنَا بِسِتْرِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wamā almamnā bihī fī shahrinā hādhā min lamam aw ithm aw waqʿanā fīhi min thanbi wa ikhtasabnā fīhi min khaṭīʾah ʿala taʿam mudammuna aw ʿala nisyan ḍalamna fiih anfusna aw intahakna bihi hurmatan min ghayrina faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi wa asturnā bisitrka
records.english_text: O God, as for the small and large sins which we have committed in this our month, the misdeeds into which we have fallen, and the offenses which we have earned purposefully or in forgetfulness, wronging ourselves thereby or violating the respect due to others, bless Muhammad and his Household, cover us over with Thy covering,

records.arabic_text: وَاعْفُ عَنَّا بِعَفْوِكَ، وَلاَ تَنْصِبْنَا فِيهِ لاِعْيُنِ الشَّامِتِينَ، وَلاَ تَبْسُطْ عَلَيْنَا فِيهِ أَلْسُنَ الطَّاعِنينَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِمَا يَكُونُ حِطَّةً وَكَفَّارَةً
records.transliteration: waʿfu ʿannā biʿafwik wa lā tanṣibnā fīhi laiʿyuni ash-shāmiteen walā tabṣuṭ ʿalaynā fīhi alsunna alṭṭāʿinin wastaʿmilnā bimā yakūnu ḥiṭṭatan wakaffāratan
records.english_text: pardon us through Thy pardoning, place us not before the eyes of the gloaters because of that, stretch not toward us the tongues of the defamers, and employ us in that which will alleviate and expiate

records.arabic_text: لِمَا أَنْكَرْتَ مِنَّا فِيهِ بِرَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَفَضْلِكَ الَّذِي لا يَنْقُصُ.
records.transliteration: lima ankarta minnā fīhi bir'aftika allatī lā tanfadu wa faḍlika alladhī lā yanquṣu
records.english_text: whatever Thou disapprovest from us within it through Thy clemency which does not run out, and Thy bounty which does not diminish!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْبُرْ مُصِيبَتنَا بِشَهْرِنَا وَبَارِكْ فِي يَوْمِ عِيْدِنَا وَفِطْرِنَا وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنْ خَيْرِ يَوْم مَرَّ عَلَيْنَا أَجْلَبِهِ لِعَفْو، وَأَمْحَاهُ لِذَنْبِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ʾajbur muṣībatanā bi-shahrinā wabārik fī yawmi ʿīdinā wa fiṭrinā waajʿalhu min khayri yawmin marr ʿalayna ajlabihi liʿafwi, waamhaahu lidhanbi
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, redress our being afflicted by our month, bless us in this day of our festival and our fast-breaking, make it one of the best of days that have passed over us, the greatest in attracting Thy pardon, and the most effacing toward sins,

records.arabic_text: وَاغْفِرْ لَنا ما خَفِيَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِنَا وَمَا عَلَنَ.
records.transliteration: wa-ghfir lana ma khafiya min dhunubina wa ma alana
records.english_text: and forgive us our sins, both the concealed and the public!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ اسلَخْنَا بِانْسِلاَخِ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ مِنْ خَطَايَانَا وَأَخْرِجْنَا بُخُرُوجِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئاتِنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ أَسْعَدِ أَهْلِهِ بِهِ وَأَجْزَلِهِمْ قِسَمَاً فِيـهِ وَأَوْفَـرِهِمْ حَظّاً مِنْـهُ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma asliḵnā bi-ansilāḵi hāḏā al-shahr min khaṭāyānā wa-akhrijnā bukhūrūjihī min sayyi’ātinā wa-ajʿalna min asʿadi ahlihi bihi wa'ajzalihim qisaman feehi wa'aufarihim hazzan minhu
records.english_text: O God, with the passing of this month make us pass forth from our offenses, with its departure make us depart from our evil deeds, and appoint us thereby among its most felicitous people, the most plentiful of them in portion, and the fullest of them in share!

records.arabic_text: أللّهُمَّ وَمَنْ رَعَى حَقّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهِ وَحَفِظَ حُرْمَتَهُ حَقَّ حِفْظِهَا وَقَامَ بِحُدُودِهِ حَقَّ قِيَامِهَا، وَأتَّقَى ذُنُوبَهُ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهَا أَوْ تَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ بِقُرْبَة أَوْجَبَتْ رِضَاكَ لَهُ وَعَطَفَتْ رَحْمَتَكَ عَلَيْهِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa man raʿā ḥaqqa hādhā alshshahri ḥaqqa riʿāyatih wa ḥafiḏa ḥurmatuhu ḥaqq ḥifẓihā wa qāma biḥuduudihi ḥaqq qiyāmih wa'attaqā dhunūbahū ḥaqqatuqātihā aw taqarraba ilayka biqurbah ʾawjabat riḍāka lahū waʿaṭafat raḥmatuka ʿalayh
records.english_text: O God, when any person observes this month as it should be observed, safeguards its inviolability as it should be safeguarded, attends to its bounds as they should be attended to, fears its misdeeds as they should be feared, or seeks nearness to Thee with any act of nearness-seeking which makes incumbent upon him Thy good pleasure and bends toward him Thy mercy,

records.arabic_text: فَهَبْ لَنَا مِثْلَهُ مِنْ وُجْدِكَ وَأَعْطِنَا أَضْعَافَهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ فَإنَّ فَضْلَكَ، لا يَغِيْضُ وَإنَّ خَـزَائِنَكَ لا تَنْقُصُ، بَـلْ تَفِيضُ وَإنَّ مَعَـادِنَ إحْسَانِكَ لا تَفْنَى،
records.transliteration: fahab lana mithlahu min wujdika wa'a'tinā 'aḍ'āfahu min faḍlika fa inna fadlaka la yaghiḍu wa inna khazā'inaka lā tanquṣu bal tafīḍu wa-inna ma'aadina ihsaanika laa tafnaa
records.english_text: give to us the like [of that] from Thy wealth and bestow it upon us in multiples through Thy bounty, for Thy bounty does not diminish, Thy treasuries do not decrease but overflow, the mines of Thy beneficence are not exhausted,

records.arabic_text: وَإنَّ عَطَاءَكَ لَلْعَطَآءُ الْمُهَنَّا،
records.transliteration: wa innā ʿaṭāʾaka lal-ʿaṭāʾu al-muhannā
records.english_text: and Thy bestowal is the bestowal full of delight!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْتُبْ لَنَا مِثْلَ أجُورِ مَنْ صَامَهُ أَوْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ فِيْهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi. wa-ktub lanā mithla ajūri man ṣāmahu aw taʿabbada lak fīhi ilā yawm al-qiyāmah
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and write for us the like of the wages of him who fasted in it or worshipped Thee within it until the Day of Resurrection!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّا نَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ فِي يَوْمِ فِطْرِنَا الّذِي جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عِيداً وَسُـرُوراً.
records.transliteration: allāhumma innā natoobu ilayka fī yawmi fiṭrinā al-ladhī jaʿaltahu lil-muʾminīna ʿīdan wa surūran
records.english_text: O God, we repent to Thee in our day of fast-breaking, which Thou hast appointed for the faithful a festival and a joy

records.arabic_text: وَلأِهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ مَجْمَعاً وَمُحْتشداً مِنْ كُلِّ ذَنْب أَذْنَبْنَاهُ، أَوْ سُوْء أَسْلَفْنَاهُ، أَوْ خَاطِرِ شَرٍّ أَضْمَرْنَاهُ، تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لاَ يَنْطَوِيْ عَلَى رُجُوع إلَى ذَنْب وَلا يَعُودُ بَعْدَهَا فِي خَطِيئَة،
records.transliteration: wa li-ahli millatika majmaʿan wa muhtashidan min kulli dhanbin adhnabnahu ʾaw suwʾa aslafnāhū, ʾaw khāṭir sharri ʾaḍmarnāhū tawbatu man lā yanṭawī ʿalā rujūʿ ilā dhamb wa lā yaʿūd baʿdahā fī khaṭīʾah
records.english_text: and for the people of Thy creed a time of assembly and gathering, from every misdeed we did, ill work we sent ahead, or evil thought we secretly conceived, the repentance of one who does not harbour a return to sin and who afterwards will not go back to offense,

records.arabic_text: تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً خَلَصَتْ مِنَ الشَّكِّ وَالارْتِيَابِ،
records.transliteration: tawbatan naṣūḥan khalaṣat mina alshakki walirtiyābi
records.english_text: an unswerving repentance rid of doubt and wavering.

records.arabic_text: فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنَّا وَارْضَ عَنَّا وَثَبِّتنَا عَلَيْهَا.
records.transliteration: fataqabbalhā minnā, warḍa ʿannā, wathabbitnā ʿalayhā
records.english_text: So accept it from us, be pleased with us, and fix us within it!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا خَوْفَ عِقَابِ الْوَعِيدِ، وَشَوْقَ ثَوَابِ الْمَوْعُودِ حَتّى نَجِدَ لَذَّةَ مَا نَدْعُوكَ بِهِ، وكَأْبَةَ مَا نَسْتَجِيْرُكَ مِنْهُ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma arzuqnā khawfa ʿiqābi al-waʿīd wa shawqa thawabi al-maw'oodi hatta najida ladhdhata ma nad'ooka bihi waka'bat ma nastaajiruka minhu
records.english_text: God, provide us with fear of the threatened punishment and yearning for the promised reward, so that we may find the pleasure of that for which we supplicate Thee and the sorrow of that from which we seek sanctuary in Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْنَا عِنْدَكَ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ الَّذِينَ أَوْجَبْتَ لَهُمْ مَحَبَّتَكَ، وَقَبِلْتَ مِنْهُمْ مُرَاجَعَةَ طَاعَتِكَ، يَا أَعْدَلَ الْعَادِلِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa-jaʿalna ʿinda-ka mina ttawwabiyna llaḏiyna 'awjabta lahum maḥabbataka wa qabilta minhum murajaaʿata taʿatika, yaa aʿdala al-ʿaadiliin
records.english_text: And place us with Thee among the repenters, those upon whom Thou hast made Thy love obligatory and from whom Thou hast accepted the return to obeying Thee! O Most Just of the just!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبآئِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِيْنِنَا جَمِيعاً مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma tajāwaz ʿan ābāʾinā wa ʾummahātinā wa ahli dīninā jamīʿan man salafa minhum wa man ghabara ila yawm al-qiyamah
records.english_text: O God, show forbearance toward our fathers and our mothers and all the people of our religion, those who have gone and those who will pass by, until the Day of Resurrection!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد نَبِيِّنَا وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَلائِكَتِكَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad nabiyyinā wa ālih kamā ṣallayta ʿalā malāʾikatika almuqarrabīn
records.english_text: O God, bless our prophet Muhammad and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy angels brought nigh,

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَأَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
records.transliteration: waṣallī ʿalayhi wa ālihi kamā ṣallayta ʿalā anbiyāika al-mursalīn wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ālihi, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā ʿibādika aṣ-ṣāliḥ wa afḍala min dhālika yā rab al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: bless him and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy prophets sent out, bless him and his Household, as Thou hast blessed Thy righteous servants - and better than that, O Lord of the worlds!

records.arabic_text: صَلاَةً تَبْلُغُنَا بَرَكَتُهَا، وَيَنَالُنَا نَفْعُهَا، وَيُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا دُعَاؤُنَا،
records.transliteration: ṣalātan tablugunā barakatuhā, wa yanālunā nafʿuhā wayustajābu lahā duʿā'unā
records.english_text: a blessing whose benediction will reach us, whose benefit will attain to us, and through which our supplication may be granted!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ أكْرَمُ مَنْ رُغِبَ إلَيْهِ وَأكْفَى مَنْ تُوُكِّلَ عَلَيْهِ وَأَعْطَى مَنْ سُئِلَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ.
records.transliteration: 'innaka akramu man rughiba ilayhi wa akfā man tuwukkila ʿalayh wa-aʿṭā man suʾila min faḍlihi wa-anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr
records.english_text: Thou art the most generous of those who are beseeched, the most sufficient of those in whom confidence is had, the most bestowing of those from whom bounty is asked, and Thou art powerful over everything!

readings.title: 46. On the Day of Fast-Breaking and on Friday
readings.arabicTitle: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي عِيدِ الْفِطْرِ وَ الْجُمُعَةِ
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ.
records.transliteration: yā man yarḥamu man lā yarḥamuhu al-ʿibād
records.english_text: O He who has mercy upon him toward whom the servants show no mercy!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلاَدُ.
records.transliteration: wayā man yaqbalu man lā taqbaluhu albilād
records.english_text: O He who accepts him whom the cities will not accept!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَن لاَ يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إلَيْهِ.
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā yahtaqiru ahl al-ḥājaẗi ilayh
records.english_text: O He who looks not down upon those who have need of Him!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُخَيِّبُ المَلِحِّيْنَ عَلَيْـهِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā yukhayyibu al-malihhīna ʿalayhi
records.english_text: O He who disappoints not those who implore Him!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَليهِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā yajbahū bi-r-raddi ahlad-dāllati ʿalayhi
records.english_text: O He who slaps not the brow of the people of boldness toward Him with rejection!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَايُتْحَفُ بِهِ، وَيَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا يُعْمَلُ لَهُ.
records.transliteration: wa yā man yajtabi ṣaghīra mayutḥafu bihī wa yashkur yasira ma yu'malu lahu
records.english_text: O He who collects the little that is given to Him and shows gratitude for the paltry that is done for Him!

records.arabic_text: وَيَامَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيْلِ، وَيُجَازيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ،
records.transliteration: wa yaman yashkur ʿalal-qaleel, wa yujāzi bil-jaleel
records.english_text: O He who shows gratitude for the small and rewards with the great!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إلَى مَنْ دَنا مِنْهُ
records.transliteration: wayā man yadnū ʾilā man dana minhu
records.english_text: O He who comes close to him who comes close to Him!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَدعُو إلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
records.transliteration: wayā man yadʿū ilā nafsihi man ʾadbar ʿanhū
records.english_text: O He who invites to Himself him who turns his back on Him!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
records.transliteration: wa yā man lā yughayyiru al-niʿmata, wa lā yubādiru bi al-naqimah
records.english_text: O He who changes not favour and rushes not to vengeance!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا، وَيَتَجَاوَزُ عَنِ السَّيِّئَةِ حَتَّى يُعَفِّيَهَا.
records.transliteration: wayā man yuthmiru al-ḥasanah ḥattá yunmiyahā wa yatajaawazu ʿani as-sayyiʾati hatta yuʿaffiyahaa
records.english_text: O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit so that He may make it grow, and overlooks the evil deed so that He may efface it!

records.arabic_text: انْصَرَفَتِ الآمَالُ دُونَ مَدى كَرَمِكَ بِالحَاجَاتِ وَامْتَلاَتْ بِفَيْضِ جُودِكَ أَوْعِيَةُ الطَّلِبات، وَتَفَسَّخَتْ دُونَ بُلُوغِ نَعْتِـكَ الصِّفَاتُ،
records.transliteration: 'inṣarafatil-āmālu dūna madā karamika bil-ḥājāt' waamtalat bifaḍi judika aw`iyatu alṭṭalibat wa tafassakhat dunā bulūghin naʿtika al-ṣifātu
records.english_text: Hopes turn back with needs fulfilled short of the extent of Thy generosity, the cups of requests fill up with the overflow of Thy munificence, and attributes fall apart without reaching Thy description.

records.arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الأعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَال، وَالْجَلاَلُ الأمْجَدُ فَوْقَ كُلِّ جَلاَل،
records.transliteration: falakal-'uluwwul-a'la fawqa kulli 'aal wa al-jalālu al-amjadu fawqa kulli jalāl
records.english_text: For to Thee belongs the highest highness above everything high, and the most glorious majesty beyond every majesty!

records.arabic_text: كُلُّ جَلِيْل عِنْدَكَ صَغِيرٌ، وَكُلُّ شَرِيف فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
records.transliteration: kullu jaliilin 'indaka saghiirun wa kullu sharifin fi janbi sharafika haqirun
records.english_text: Everything majestic before Thee is small, everything eminent beside Thy eminence vile!

records.arabic_text: خَابَ الْوَافِدُونَ عَلَى غَيْرِكَ، وَخَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إلاَّ لَكَ، وَضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ إلاّ بِكَ، وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُـونَ إلاَّ مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
records.transliteration: khaba al-wāfidūn ʿalā ghayrika wa khasira al-mutaʿarriḍūna illā laka, wa ḍāʿa al-mulimmūna illā bika wa-ajdaba al-muntajiʿūna illā mani intajʿa fadluka
records.english_text: Those who reach other than Thee are disappointed, those who present themselves to other than Thee have lost, those who stay with other than Thee have perished, and those who retreat - except those who retreat to Thy bounty - are desolate!

records.arabic_text: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَجُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ، وَإغاثَتُكَ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِينَ،
records.transliteration: bābuka mafṭūḥun lil-rāghibīn, wa-jūduka mubāḥun li-lsāʾilīn wa-ighāthatuka qarībatun min al-mustaghīthīn
records.english_text: Thy door is open to the beseechers, Thy munificence free to the askers, Thy help near to the help-seekers!

records.arabic_text: لاَ يَخِيبُ مِنْـكَ الآمِلُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ، وَلا يَشْقَى بِنَقْمَتِكَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ.
records.transliteration: lā yakhību minkal-āmilūn, wa lā yayʾasu min ʿatāʾika al-mutaʿarridūn walā yashqā binaqmatika al-mustaghfirūn
records.english_text: The expectant are not disappointed by Thee, those who present themselves despair not of Thy bestowal, the forgiveness-seekers become not wretched through Thy vengeance!

records.arabic_text: رِزْقُكَ مَبْسُوطٌ لِمَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَحِلْمُكَ مُعْتَـرِضٌ لِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ، عَادَتُكَ الإحْسَـانُ إلَى الْمُسِيئينَ، وَسُنَّتُـكَ الإبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْمُعْتَدِينَ
records.transliteration: rizquka mabsootun liman ʿasak wa ḥil-muka muʿtaridhun liman naawaka ʿādatuka al-iḥsānu ilā al-musīʾīn wa sunnatuka al-ibqā'u ʿalā al-muʿtadīn
records.english_text: Thy provision is spread among those who disobey Thee, Thy clemency presents itself to those hostile toward Thee, Thy habit is beneficence toward the evildoers, and Thy wont is to spare the transgressors,

records.arabic_text: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ، وَصَدَّهُمْ إمْهَالُكَ عَن النُّزُوعِ.
records.transliteration: ḥattá laqad ghar-rathum ʾanātuka ʿanir-rujūʿi waṣaddahum ʾimhāluka ʿan an-nuzūʿi
records.english_text: so much so that Thy lack of haste deludes them from returning, and Thy disregard bars them from desisting!

records.arabic_text: وَإنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بهمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إلَى أَمْرِكَ، وَأَمْهَلْتَهُمْ ثِقَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِكَ، فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا، وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
records.transliteration: wa innamā taʾannayta bihim liyafee'u ilā amrik wa'amhaltahum thiqatan bidawami mulkika faman kana min ahli al-saʿādah khatamta lahū bihā wa-man kaana min ahli ash-shaqawaati khadhalatahu lahā
records.english_text: Thou actest without haste toward them so that they will come back to Thy command and Thou disregardest them confident in the permanence of Thy kingdom, so Thou sealest him who is worthy of it with felicity, and Thou abandonest him who is worthy of it to wretchedness!

records.arabic_text: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إلَى حُكْمِكَ وَأُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إلَى أَمْـرِكَ،
records.transliteration: kulluhum sa'iroon ila hukmika wa umooruhum ailatun ila amrik
records.english_text: All of them come home to Thy decree, their affairs revert to Thy command;

records.arabic_text: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ وَلَمْ يَـدْحَضْ لِتَـرْكِ مُعَاجَلَتِهِمْ بُرْهَانُكَ.
records.transliteration: lam yahin ʿalá ṭūli muddatihim sultānuk walam yadhaḍ li-tariki muʿājalatihim burhānuka
records.english_text: Thy authority grows not feeble through their drawn out term, Thy proof is not refuted by the failure to hurry after them.

records.arabic_text: حُجَّتُكَ قَائِمَةٌ لاَ تُدْحَضُ، وَسُلْطَانُكَ ثَابِتٌ لا يَزُولُ،
records.transliteration: ḥujjatuka qāʾimah lā tudhaḍḍh wa sulṭānuka thābitun lā yazūl
records.english_text: Thy argument is established, never refuted, Thy authority fixed, never removed.

records.arabic_text: فَالْوَيْلُ الدَّائِمُ لِمَنْ جَنَحَ عَنْكَ، وَالْخَيْبَةُ الْخَاذِلَةُ لِمَنْ خَابَ مِنْكَ، وَالشَّقاءُ الاشْقَى لِمَنِ اغْتَرَّ بِكَ.
records.transliteration: fa al-waylu al-da'imu liman janaha 'anka wal-khaybah al-khāẓilah liman khāba minka wa alshshaqā'u alashqa li mani ightarra bika
records.english_text: Permanent woe belongs to him who inclines away from Thee, forsaking disappointment to him who is disappointed by Thee, and the most wretched wretchedness to him who is deluded about Thee!

records.arabic_text: مَا أكْثَرَ تَصَرُّفَهُ فِي عَذَابِكَ،
records.transliteration: mā akthara taṣarrufahu fī ʿadhābika
records.english_text: How much he will move about in Thy chastisement!

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَطْوَلَ تَرَدُّدَهُ فِيْ عِقَابِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa mā aṭwal taraddudahu fī ʿiqābika
records.english_text: How long he will frequent Thy punishment!

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَبْعَدَ غَايَتَهُ مِنَ الْفَرَجِ،
records.transliteration: wa mā ʾabʿada ghāyatahu min al-faraj
records.english_text: How far his utmost end from relief!

records.arabic_text: وَمَا أَقْنَطَهُ مِنْ سُهُولَةِ الْمَخْرَجِ
records.transliteration: wa mā aqnathu min suhulati al-makhraj
records.english_text: How he will despair of an easy exit!

records.arabic_text: عَدْلاً مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لاَ تَجُورُ فِيهِ، وَإنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لاَ تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
records.transliteration: ʿadlan min qaḍāʾika lā tajūru fīhi wa-inṣāfan min ḥukmika lā taḥīfu ʿalayhi
records.english_text: [All of this] as justice from Thy decree (Thou art not unjust in it!), and equity from Thy judgement (Thou dost not act wrongfully against him!).

records.arabic_text: فَقَدْ ظَاهَرْتَ الْحُجَجَ، وَأَبْلَيْتَ الاعْذَارَ، وَقَـدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِـالْوَعِيْـدِ وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيْبِ، وَضَرَبْتَ الامْثَالَ، وَأَطَلْتَ الاِمْهَالَ، وَأَخَّرْتَ وَأَنْتَ مُسْتَطِيعٌ لِلْمُعَاجَلَةِ،
records.transliteration: faqad ẓahartal-ḥujaja wa ablaytal-iʿḏāra wa qad taqaddamta bil waʿīd wa taltaffat fi al-targhīb waḍarabta al-amthāl, wa-aṭalt al-imhāl wa'akhkhirta wa anta mustaṭīʿun lilmuʿājalati
records.english_text: Thou supported the arguments, tested the excuses, began with threats, showed gentleness with encouragement, struck similitudes, made long the respite, delayed, while Thou art able to hurry,

records.arabic_text: وَتَأَنَّيْتَ وَأَنْتَ مَليءٌ بِالْمُبَادَرَةِ،
records.transliteration: wa ta'annayta wa anta maly'un bilmubadara
records.english_text: and acted without haste, while Thou art full of quick accomplishment!

records.arabic_text: لَمْ تَكُنْ أَنَاتُكَ عَجْزاً، وَلا إمْهَالُكَ وَهْناً، وَلاَ إمْسَاكُكَ غَفْلَةً، وَلاَ انْتِظَارُكَ مُدَارَاةً،
records.transliteration: lam takun 'anatuka 'ajzan, wa-la 'imhaluka wahnan walā imsākuka ghaflah, walā intiẓāruka mudārāh
records.english_text: Not because of incapacity is Thy slowness, feebleness Thy giving respite, heedlessness Thy showing restraint, dissemblance Thy waiting!

records.arabic_text: بَلْ لِتَكُونَ حُجَّتُكَ أَبْلَغَ، وَكَرَمُكَ أكمَلَ، وَإحْسَانُكَ أَوْفَى وَنِعْمَتُكَ أَتَمَّ،
records.transliteration: bal litakūna ḥujjatuka ablagh, wa karamuka akmal wa-iḥsānuka awfā wa-niʿmatuka atamma
records.english_text: But that Thy argument be more conclusive, Thy generosity more perfect, Thy beneficence more exhaustive, Thy favour more complete!

records.arabic_text: كُلُّ ذلِكَ كَانَ وَلَمْ تَزَلْ، وَهُوَ كائِنٌ وَلاَ تَزَالُ ،
records.transliteration: kullu dhālika kāna wa lam tazal, wa huwa kā'inun wa lā tazālu
records.english_text: All of this has been and always was, is and ever will be.

records.arabic_text: حُجَّتُكَ أَجَلُّ مِنْ أَنْ توصَفَ بِكُلِّهَا، وَمَجْدُكَ أَرْفَـعُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحَدَّ بِكُنْهِهِ، وَنِعْمَتُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُحْصَى بِأَسْرِهَا، وَإحْسَانُكَ أكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ تُشْكَرَ عَلَى أَقَلِّهِ،
records.transliteration: ḥujjatuka ʾajallu min an tūṣafa bikullihā wa majduka arfa'u min an yuhadda bikunhihi wa niʿmatuka aktharu min an tuḥṣā bi-asrihā wa-iḥsānuka aktharu min an tushkara ʿalā aqallih
records.english_text: Thy argument is greater than that its totality be described, Thy glory more elevated than that it be limited in its core, Thy favour more abundant than that its entirety be counted, Thy beneficence more abundant than that thanks be given for its least amount!

records.arabic_text: وَقَدْ قَصَّرَ بِيَ السُّكُوتُ عَنْ تَحْمِيدِكَ، وَفَهَّهَنِي الإمْسَاكُ عَنْ تَمْجيدِكَ، وَقُصَارَايَ الإقْرَارُ بِالْحُسُورِ لاَ رَغْبَةً ـ يا إلهِي ـ بَلْ عَجْزاً،
records.transliteration: waqad qassara biya al-sukutu ʿan tahmidiكَ، wa fahhahani al-im'sāku ʿan tamjīdik wa quṣārāy al-iqrār bi al-ḥusoor lā raghbaṭan, yā ilāhī, bal ʿajzan
records.english_text: Speechlessness has made me fall short of praising Thee, restraint has made me powerless to glorify Thee, and the most I can do is admit to inability, not out of desire, my God, but out of incapacity.

records.arabic_text: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا أَؤُمُّكَ بِالْوِفَادَةِ، وَأَسأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الرِّفَادَةِ، فَصلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاسْمَعْ نَجْوَايَ، وَاسْتَجِبْ دُعَائِي وَلاَ تَخْتِمْ يَوْمِيَ بِخَيْبَتِي، وَلاَ تَجْبَهْنِي بِالرَّدِّ فِي مَسْأَلَتِي،
records.transliteration: fahā anā dhā aʾummuka bil-wifādah, wa as'aluka ḥusn ar-riifādah faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa-smaʿ najwaya wa-istajib du'ā'ī wa-lā takhtim yawmiya bi-khaybati wa lā tajbah-nī bir-raddi fī mas'alatī
records.english_text: So here I am: I repair to Thee by coming forward, and I ask from Thee good support So bless Muhammad and his Household, hear my whispered words, grant my supplication, seal not my day with disappointment, slap not my brow by rejecting my request,

records.arabic_text: وَأكْرِمْ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مُنْصَرَفِي وَإلَيْكَ مُنْقَلَبِي،
records.transliteration: waakrim min ʿindika munṣarafī waʾilayka munqalabī
records.english_text: and make noble my coming from Thee and my going back to Thee!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ غَيْرُ ضَائِق بِمَا تُرِيْدُ وَلاَ عَاجِزٍ عَمَّا تُسْأَلُ،
records.transliteration: 'innaka ghayru ḍā'iq bimā turīdu walā ʿājiz 'ammā tusalu
records.english_text: Surely Thou art not constrained by what Thou desirest, nor incapable of what Thou art asked!

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيْرٌ، وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ إلاَّ بِاللهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ.
records.transliteration: wa-anta ʿala kulli shay'in qadīrun wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāhi al-ʿaliyyi al-ʿaẓīm
records.english_text: Thou art powerful over everything, and there is no force and no strength save in God, the All-high, the All-mighty!

readings.title: 47. His Supplication on the Day of 'Arafa
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
records.transliteration: al-ḥamdu lillāh rabbi al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: "Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds" (1:2)!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ لَـكَ الْحَمْدُ بَدِيْعَ السَّموَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ،
records.transliteration: allahumma laka alhamdu badi' al-samawati wa al-ard
records.english_text: O God, to Thee belongs praise! Originator of the heavens and the earth!

records.arabic_text: ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
records.transliteration: dhā al-jalāli wal-ikrām
records.english_text: Possessor of majesty and munificence!

records.arabic_text: رَبَّ الاَرْبَابِ وَإلهَ كُلِّ مَألُوه،
records.transliteration: rabb al-arbāb wa-ilāh kulli maʾaluh
records.english_text: Lord of lords! Object of worship of every worshiper!

records.arabic_text: وَخَالِقَ كُلِّ مَخْلُوق،
records.transliteration: wa khāliqa kulli makhlooq
records.english_text: Creator of every creature!

records.arabic_text: وَوَارِثَ كُلِّ شَيْء، لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَـيْءٌ، وَلا يَعْزُبُ عَنْهُ عِلْمُ شَيْء، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْء مُحِيطٌ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء رَقِيبٌ،
records.transliteration: wa waritha kulli shay'in, laysa kamithlihi shay'un wa lā yaʿzubu ʿanhu ʿilmu shayʾ wa huwa bikulli shay'in muheetun wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in raqīb
records.english_text: Inheritor of all things! "There is nothing like Him" (42:11), knowledge of nothing escapes Him, He "encompasses everything" (41:54), and He is watchful over everything (ref.33:52).

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الله لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الاَحَـدُ الْمُتَوَحِّدُ الْفَرْدُ الْمُتَفَرِّدُ،
records.transliteration: 'anta allāh lā ilāha illā 'anta al-'aḥadu al-mutawaḥḥidu al-fard al-mutafarridu
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Unique, the Alone, the Single, the Isolated.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الْمُتَكَرِّمُ، الْعَظِيمُ الْمُتَعَظِّمُ، الْكَبِيرُ الْمُتَكَبِّرُ.
records.transliteration: wa anta allāhu lā ilāha illā anta al-karīmu al-mutakarrimu al-ʿaẓīmu al-mutaʿaẓẓimu, al-kabīru al-mutakabbiru
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Generous, the Generously Bestowing, the All-mighty, the Mightily Exalted, the Magnificent, the Magnificently Magnified.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ العَلِيُّ الْمُتَعَالِ، الْشَدِيْدُ الْمِحَـالِ.
records.transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-'aliyyu al-muta'aal, al-shadiidu al-mihaal
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-high, the Sublimely High, "the Strong in prowess" (13:13).

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ الـرَّحْمنُ الرَّحِيمُ الْعَلِيمُ الْحَكِيمُ.
records.transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, ar-rahmanu ar-rahim, al-'alimu al-hakim
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-merciful, the All-compassionate, the All-knowing, the All-wise.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْبَصِيرُ الْقَدِيمُ الْخَبِيرُ،
records.transliteration: wa anta allahu la ilaha illa anta, assamīʿu al-baṣīru al-qadīmu al-khabīru
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the All-hearing, the All-seeing, the Eternal, the All-aware.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الاَكْرَمُ الدَّائِمُ الادْوَمُ،
records.transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-karim al-akram, al-daim al-adwam
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Generous, the Most Generous, the Everlasting, the Most Everlasting.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الاوَّلُ قَبْلَ كُلِّ أَحَد وَالاخِرُ بَعْدَ كُلِّ عَدَد،
records.transliteration: wa anta allah, la ilaha illa anta, al-awwal qabla kulli ahadin wa al-ākhiru baʿda kulli ʿadad
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the First before every one, the Last after every number.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لا إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الدَّانِي فِي عُلُوِّهِ، وَالْعَالِي فِي دُنُوِّهِ،
records.transliteration: wa anta allahu la ilaha illa anta addani fi 'uluwwihi wal-ʿālī fī dunyāhi
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, the Close in His highness, the High in His closeness.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ ذُو الْبَهَاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ.
records.transliteration: wa anta allāh lā ilāha illā anta dhū al-bahā'i wal-majdi wal-kibriyā'i wal-ḥamd
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou, Possessor of radiance and glory, magnificence and praise.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ اللهُ لاَ إلهَ إلاّ أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأْتَ الاشْيَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سِنْخ، وَصَوَّرْتَ مَا صَوَّرْتَ مِنْ غَيْرِ مِثال، وَابْتَدَعْتَ الْمُبْتَدَعَاتِ بِلاَ احْتِذَآء.
records.transliteration: wa-anta allāh lā ilāha illā anta al-ladhī anshata al-ashyā'a min ghayr sinakh wa ṣawwartama ṣawwartamin ghayri mithāl wa ibtadat al-mubtadaʿat bi-lā ihtidhāʾ
records.english_text: Thou art God, there is no god but Thou. Thou hast brought forth the things without root, formed what Thou hast formed without exemplar, and originated the originated things without limitation.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي قَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَقْدِيراً وَيَسَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَيْسِيراً، وَدَبَّرْتَ مَا دُونَكَ تَدْبِيْراً.
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhi qaddarta kulla shay'in taqdiran wayassart(a) kulla shay'in taysira(n) wadabbar-ta mā doonaka tadbeeran
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast ordained each thing with an ordination, eased each thing with an easing, and governed everything below Thyself with a governing.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنْتَ الَّذِي لَمْ يُعِنْكَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ شَرِيكٌ وَلَمْ يُؤازِرْكَ فِي أَمْرِكَ وَزِيرٌ،
records.transliteration: wa anta allathi lam yu`inaka `ala khalqika shariqun walam yuʾāzirka fī amrika wazīrun
records.english_text: It is Thou whom no associate helps with Thy creation and no vizier aids in Thy command.

records.arabic_text: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ مُشَاهِدٌ وَلا نَظِيرٌ.
records.transliteration: wa lam yakun laka mushahidun wala nathirun
records.english_text: Thou hast no witness and no equal.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَرَدْتَ فَكَانَ حَتْماً مَا أَرَدْتَ، وَقَضَيْتَ فَكَانَ عَدْلاً مَا قَضَيْتَ، وَحَكَمْتَ فَكَانَ نِصْفاً مَا حَكَمْتَ،
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhī aradta fakāna ḥatman mā aradta waqaḍayta fakāna ʿadlan mā qaḍayta waḥakamta fakana niṣfan mā ḥakamta
records.english_text: It is Thou who willed, and what Thou willed was unfailing, who decreed, and what Thou decreed was just, who decided, and what Thou decided was fair.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّـذِي لا يَحْوِيْـكَ مَكَانٌ وَلَمْ يَقُمْ لِسُلْطَانِكَ سُلْطَانٌ، وَلَمْ يُعْيِكَ بُرْهَانٌ وَلا بَيَانٌ.
records.transliteration: anta alladhi la yahwik maakan walam yaqum lisultanika sultanun walam yuʿyika burhanun wala bayanun
records.english_text: It is Thou whom place does not contain, before whose authority no authority stands up, and whom no proof or explication can thwart.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَحْصَيْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء عَدَدَاً، وَجَعَلْتَ لِكُلِّ شَيْء أَمَداً، وَقَدَّرْتَ كُلَّ شَيْء تَقْدِيْراً.
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhi 'ahsayta kulla shay'in 'adada wa jaʿalta likulli shay'in amadan wa qaddarta kulla shay'in taqdeeran
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast counted everything in numbers, appointed for everything a term, and ordained everything with an ordination.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي قَصُرَتِ الاوْهَامُ عَنْ ذَاتِيَّتِكَ، وَعَجَزَتِ الافْهَامُ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّتِكَ ، وَلَمْ تُدْرِكِ الابْصَارُ مَوْضِعَ أَيْنِيَّتِكَ.
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhī qasurat al-awhāmu 'an dhātiyyatika waʿajazati al-afhāmu ʿan kayfiyyatika wa lam tudrikil-absaru mawdi'a 'ayniyyatika
records.english_text: It is Thou before whose selfness imaginations fall short, before whose howness understandings have no incapacity, and the place of whose whereness eyes perceive not.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي لا تُحَدُّ فَتَكُونَ مَحْدُوداً، وَلَمْ تُمَثَّلْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْجُوداً، وَلَمْ تَلِدْ فَتَكُونَ مَوْلُوداً.
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhī lā tuḥaddu fatakūna maḥdūdan walum tumaththal fatakoona mawjoodan walum talid fatakoonu mawloodan
records.english_text: It is Thou who hast no bounds, lest Thou be bounded, who art not exemplified, lest Thou be found, who dost not beget, lest Thou be begotten.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي لا ضِدَّ مَعَكَ فَيُعَانِدَكَ، وَلا عِدْلَ فَيُكَاثِرَكَ، وَلاَ نِدَّ لَكَ فَيُعَارِضَكَ.
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhī lā ḍidda ma'aka fayuʿānidaka walā ʿidlun fayukāthiraka, walā niddun lak fayuʿāriḍaka
records.english_text: It is Thou with whom there is no opposite, lest it contend with Thee, who hast no equal, lest it vie with Thee, who hast no rival, lest it resist Thee.

records.arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّـذِي ابْتَدَأ وَاخْتَـرَعَ وَاسْتَحْدَثَ وَابْتَـدَعَ وَأَحْسَنَ صُنْعَ مَا صَنَعَ،
records.transliteration: 'anta alladhi ibtada wa-ikhtara'a wa-istahdatha wa'ibtada'a wa ahsana sunʿa ma sanʿa
records.english_text: It is Thou who art He who began, devised, brought forth, originated, and made well all that He made.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحانَكَ! مَا أَجَلَّ شَأنَكَ،
records.transliteration: subḥānaka! mā ʾajalla shaʾnaka
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! How majestic is Thy station!

records.arabic_text: وَأَسْنَى فِي الامَاكِنِ مَكَانَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa asnaa fil amākin makaanaka
records.english_text: How high Thy place among the places!

records.arabic_text: وَأَصْدَعَ بِالْحَقِّ فُرقَانَكَ.
records.transliteration: wa-asda'a bil-haqqi furqānaka
records.english_text: How cleanly Thy Separator cleaves with the truth!

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ لَطِيفٍ مَا أَلْطَفَكَ،
records.transliteration: subḥānaka min laṭīfin mā alṭafaka
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! The Gentle - how gentle Thou art!

records.arabic_text: وَرَؤُوفٍ مَا أَرْأَفَكَ، وَحَكِيمٍ مَا أَعْرَفَكَ!
records.transliteration: warā'ūfin mā ar'afaka, waḥakīmin mā aʿrafaka!
records.english_text: The Clement - how clement Thou art! The Wise - how knowing Thou art!

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ مِنْ مَلِيْكٍ مَا أَمْنَعَكَ،
records.transliteration: subḥānaka min malikin mā amnaʿaka
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! The King - how invincible Thou art!

records.arabic_text: وَجَوَادٍ مَا أَوْسَعَكَ، وَرَفِيعٍ مَا أَرْفَعَكَ،
records.transliteration: wajawādin mā awsʿaka, warafīʿin mā arfaʿaka
records.english_text: The Munificent - how full of plenty Thou art! The Elevated - how elevated Thou art!

records.arabic_text: ذُو الْبَهاءِ وَالْمَجْدِ وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ وَالْحَمْدِ .
records.transliteration: dhū al-bahā'i wal-majdi wal-kibrīyā'i wal-ḥamd
records.english_text: Possessor of radiance and glory, magnificence and praise!

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَسَطْتَ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ يَدَكَ وَعُرِفَتِ الْهِدَايَةُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، فَمَنِ الْتَمَسَكَ لِدِينٍ أَوْ دُنْيا وَجَدَكَ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka basaṭta bil-khayrāt yadaka waʿurifati-l-hidāyatu min ʿindika fa mani al-tamassaka l-din aw dunya wajadaka
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thou hast stretched forth Thy hand with good things, and from Thee guidance has come to be known, so he who begs from Thee religion or this world will find Thee.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ خَضَعَ لَكَ مَنْ جَرى فِي عِلْمِكَ، وَخَشَعَ لِعَظَمَتِكَ مَا دُونَ عَرْشِكَ، وَانْقَادَ لِلتَّسْلِيْمِ لَكَ كُلُّ خَلْقِكَ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka khaḍaʿa laka man jarā fī ʿilmika wa-khashaʿa li-ʿazhamatika mā dūna ʿarshika wa inqaḍa li-ttaslīm lika kullu khalqika
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! Whatever passes in Thy knowledge is subjected to Thee, all below Thy Throne are humbled before Thy mightiness, and every one of Thy creatures follows Thee in submission.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ لاَ تُحَسَّ، وَلاَ تُجَسُّ، وَلاَ تُمَسُّ، وَلاَ تُكَادُ، وَلاَ تُمَاطُ، وَلاَ تُنَازَعُ، وَلاَ تُجَارى، وَلاَ تُمارى، وَلاَ تُخَادَعُ، وَلاَ تُمَاكَرُ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka lā tuḥassa, wa lā tujassu, wa lā tumassu walā tukādu, walā tumāṭu, walā tunāzaʿu, walā tujārī wa lā tumārā, walā tu kh ādāʿu, walā tu mākāru
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thou art not sensed, nor touched, nor felt, nor beguiled, nor held back, nor challenged, nor kept up with, nor resisted, nor deceived, nor circumvented.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ سَبِيلُكَ جَدَدٌ، وَأَمْرُكَ رَشَدٌ، وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ صَمَدٌ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka sabiluka jadadun, wa amruk rashadun, wa ʾanta ḥayyun ṣamadun
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thy path is smooth ground, Thy command right guidance, and Thou art a living, eternal refuge.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ قَوْلُكَ حُكْمٌ، وَقَضَآؤُكَ حَتْمٌ، وَإرَادَتُكَ عَزْمٌ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka qawluka ḥukmun, wa qaḍā'uka ḥatmun, wa irādatuka ʿazmun
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! Thy word is decisive, Thy decree unfailing, Thy will resolute.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ لاَ رَادَّ لِمَشِيَّتِكَ، وَلاَ مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَاتِكَ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka lā radda li-mashiyatika wa-lā mubaddila li-kalimātika
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee! None can reject Thy wish, none can change Thy words.

records.arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ بَاهِرَ الايآتِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ بَارِئ، النَّسَماتِ.
records.transliteration: subḥānaka bāhiral-āyāti, fāṭiral-samāwāti bāriʾan-nasamāti
records.english_text: Glory be to Thee, Outdazzling in signs, Creator of the heavens, Author of the spirits!

records.arabic_text: لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدَاً يَدُومُ بِدَوامِكَ،
records.transliteration: laka al-ḥamd, ḥamdan yadūmu bidāwik
records.english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will be permanent with Thy permanence!

records.arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً خَالِداً بِنِعْمَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamdu ḥamdan khālidan binīʿmatika
records.english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise everlasting through Thy favour!

records.arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يُوَازِي صُنْعَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamdu ḥamdan yuwāzī ṣunʿaka
records.english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will parallel Thy benefaction!

records.arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً يَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ،
records.transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamd, ḥamdān yazeedu ʿala riḍaak
records.english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise that will increase Thy good pleasure!

records.arabic_text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْداً مَعَ حَمْدِ كُلِّ حَامِد، وَشُكْراً يَقْصُرُ عَنْهُ شُكْرُ كُلِّ شَاكِر،
records.transliteration: wa laka al-ḥamd ḥamdan maʿa ḥamdi kulli hāmid wa shukran yaqṣuru ʿanhū shukru kulli shākir
records.english_text: To Thee belongs praise, a praise along with the praise of every praiser and a thanksgiving before which falls short the thanksgiving of every thanksgiver;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً لاَ يَنْبَغِي إلاَّ لَكَ، وَلاَ يُتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إلاَّ إلَيْكَ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan lā yanbaghī illā lak wa lā yutaqarrabu bihī illā ʾilayka
records.english_text: a praise which is suitable for none but Thee and through which nearness is sought to none but Thee;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يُسْتَدَامُ بِهِ الاَوَّلُ، وَيُسْتَدْعَى بِهِ دَوَامُ الاخِرِ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan yustadāmu bihī al-awwalu wa yustadaʿā bihī dawāmu al-ākhiri
records.english_text: a praise which will make permanent the first [bounty] and call forth the permanence of the last;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يَتَضَاعَفُ عَلَى كُرُورِ الاَزْمِنَةِ، وَيَتَزَايَدُ أَضْعَافَاً مُتَرَادِفَةً،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan yataḍāʿafu ʿalā kurūri al-azminah wayatazāyadu 'aḍʿāfān mutarādifatan
records.english_text: a praise which will multiply through recurrence of times and increase through successive doublings;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يَعْجِزُ عَنْ إحْصَآئِهِ الْحَفَظَةُ، وَيَزِيدُ عَلَى مَا أَحْصَتْهُ فِي كِتابِكَ الْكَتَبَةُ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdān yaʿjizu ʿan iḥṣāʾihi al-ḥafẓatu wayazīdu ʿalā mā aḥṣathu fī kitābika al-katābah
records.english_text: a praise which the guardians will not be able to number and which exceeds what the writers number in Thy Book;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يُوازِنُ عَرْشَكَ المَجِيْدَ، وَيُعَادِلُ كُرْسِيَّكَ الرَّفِيعَ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan yuwāzinu ʿarshaka almaḥīda wayuʿādilu kursiyyaka al-rafiʿa
records.english_text: a praise which will counterbalance Thy glorious Throne and equal Thy elevated Footstool;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يَكْمُلُ لَدَيْكَ ثَوَابُهُ، وَيَسْتَغْرِقُ كُلَّ جَزَآء جَزَآؤُهُ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdān yakmulu ladayka thawābuhu wa yastaghriqu kulla jazā'in jazā'uhu
records.english_text: a praise whose reward with Thee will be complete and whose recompense will comprise every recompense;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً ظَاهِرُهُ وَفْقٌ لِبَاطِنِهِ، وَبَاطِنُهُ وَفْقٌ لِصِدْقِ النِّيَّةِِ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan ẓāhiruhu wafqun libāṭinihi wa bāṭinuhu wafqun li ṣidqi al-niyyah
records.english_text: a praise whose outward conforms to its inward, and whose inward conforms to correct intention;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً لَمْ يَحْمَدْكَ خَلْقٌ مِثْلَهُ، وَلاَ يَعْرِفُ أَحَدٌ سِوَاكَ فَضْلَهُ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan lam yaḥmadka khalqun mithlahu walā yaʿrifu ʾaḥadun siwāka faḍlahu
records.english_text: a praise with whose like no creature has praised Thee and whose excellence none knows but Thou;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يُعَانُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ فِي تَعْدِيْدِهِ، وَيُؤَيَّدُ مَنْ أَغْرَقَ نَزْعَاً فِي تَوْفِيَتِهِ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan yuʿānu mani jtaḥada fī taʿdeedih wa yu'ayyadu man aghraqa nazʿan fi tawfiyatihi
records.english_text: a praise in which he who strives to multiply Thy praise will be helped and he who draws the bow to the utmost in fulfilling it will be confirmed;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يَجْمَعُ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الْحَمْدِ، وَيَنْتَظِمُ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ بَعْدُ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdān yajmaʿu mā khalaqta min al-ḥamdi wa yantazimu ma anta khaliquhu min baʿdu
records.english_text: a praise which will gather all the praise which Thou hast created and tie together all which Thou wilt afterwards create;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً لاَ حَمْدَ أَقْرَبُ إلَى قَوْلِكَ مِنْهُ، وَلاَ أَحْمَدَ مِمَّنْ يَحْمَدُكَ بِهِ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan lā ḥamda aqrabu ʾilā qawlika minhu wa lā ʾaḥmada mimmān yaḥmaduka bihī
records.english_text: a praise than which no praise is nearer to Thy word and than which none is greater from any who praise Thee;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يُوجِبُ بِكَرَمِكَ الْمَزِيدَ بِوُفُورِهِ وَتَصِلُهُ بِمَزِيْد بَعْدَ مَزِيْد طَوْلاً مِنْكَ،
records.transliteration: ḥamdan yūjib bika ramika al-mazīda biwufūrihi wa taṣiluhu bimazīd baʿda mazīd ṭawlān mink
records.english_text: a praise whose fullness will obligate increase through Thy generosity and to which Thou wilt join increase after increase as graciousness from Thee;

records.arabic_text: حَمْداً يَجِبُ لِكَرَمِ وَجْهِكَ، وَيُقَابِلُ عِزَّ جَلاَلِكَ.
records.transliteration: ḥamdān yajibu li-karami wajhika wa yuqābilu ʿizza jalālika
records.english_text: a praise that will befit the generosity of Thy face and meet the might of Thy majesty!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِ مُحَمَّد الْمُنْتَجَبِ، الْمُصْطَفَى، الْمُكَرَّمِ، الْمُقَرَّبِ، أَفْضَلَ صَلَوَاتِكَ، وَبارِكْ عَلَيْهِ أَتَمَّ بَرَكاتِكَ،
records.transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa āli muḥammad al-muntajabi, al-mustafa al-mukarramī, al-muqarrabī, afḍala ṣalawātika wa bārik ʿalayhi atammabarakātika
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, the distinguished, the chosen, the honoured, the brought nigh, with the most excellent of Thy blessings, benedict him with the most complete of Thy benedictions,

records.arabic_text: وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَيْهِ أَمْتَعَ رَحَمَاتِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa tarahham `alayhi amt`a rahmatika
records.english_text: and have mercy upon him with the most enjoyable of Thy mercies!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً زَاكِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاَةٌ أَزْكَى مِنْهَا،
records.transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa-ālih, ṣalātan zākiyatān lā takūnu ṣalātun azkā minhā
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a fruitful blessing, more fruitful than which there is no blessing!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً نَامِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاةٌ أَنْمَى مِنْهَا،
records.transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi ṣalātan nāmiyatān lā takūnu ṣalātun ʾanmā minhā
records.english_text: Bless him with a growing blessing, more growing than which there is no blessing!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاةً رَاضِيَةً، لاَ تَكُونُ صَلاةٌ فَوْقَهَا.
records.transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi ṣalātan rāḍiyatan lā takūnu ṣalātun fawqahā
records.english_text: And bless him with a pleasing blessing, beyond which there is no blessing!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً تُرْضِيهِ وَتَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاهُ،
records.transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan turḍīhi wa tazīdu ʿalā riḍāh
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will please him and increase his good pleasure!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً تُرْضِيكَ وَتَزِيدُ عَلَى رِضَاكَ لَهُ،
records.transliteration: wa salli ʿalayhi ṣalātan turḍīka wa tazīdu ʿalā riḍāka lah
records.english_text: Bless him with a blessing which will please Thee and increase Thy good pleasure toward him!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةً لاَ تَرْضَى لَهُ إلاَّ بِهَا، وَلاَ تَرى غَيْرَهُ لَهَا أَهْلاً.
records.transliteration: wa ṣallī ʿalayhi ṣalātan lā tardhā lahū ʾillā bihā wa lā tará ghayrahá lahā áhlān
records.english_text: And bless him with a blessing through other than which Thou wilt not be pleased for him, and for which Thou seest no one else worthy!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، صَلاَةً تُجَاوِزُ رِضْوَانَكَ، وَيَتَّصِلُ اتِّصَالُهَا بِبَقَآئِكَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَدُ كَمَا لاَ تَنْفَدُ كَلِماتُكَ.
records.transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan tujāwizu riḍwānaka, wayattasilu attiṣāluhā bibaqā'ika wala yanfadu kama la tanfadu kalimatuka
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will pass beyond Thy good pleasure, be continuous in its continuity through Thy subsistence, and never be spent, just as Thy words will never be spent!
