records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً تَنْتَظِمُ صَلَوَاتِ مَلائِكَتِكَ وَأَنْبِيآئِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ وَأَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ.
records.transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi wa ālihi ṣalātan tantaziimu ṣalawāti malā'ikatika wa anbiyā'ika wa rusulika wa ahl ṭāʿatika
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will tie together the blessings of Thy angels, Thy prophets, Thy messengers, and those who obey Thee,

records.arabic_text: وَتَشْتَمِلُ عَلَى صَلَوَاتِ عِبَادِكَ مِنْ جِنّكَ وَإنْسِكَ وَأَهْلِ إجَابَتِكَ، وَتَجْتَمِعُ عَلَى صَلاَةِ كُلِّ مَنْ ذَرَأْتَ وَبَرَأْتَ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ خَلْقِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa tash tamilu ʿala ṣalawāti ʿibādika min jinnika wa'insika wa'ahl ijabatika wa tajtamiʿu ʿala ṣalāti kulli man dharaʾt wa barāʾta min asnāfi khalqik
records.english_text: comprise the blessings of Thy servants, jinn or mankind, and those worthy of Thy response, and bring together the blessings of every one of the kinds of Thy creatures which Thou hast sown and authored!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ صَلاَةً تُحِيطُ بِكُلِّ صَلاَة سَالِفَة وَمُسْتَأْنَفَة،
records.transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ālihi ṣalātan tuḥīṭu bikulli ṣalātin sālifatin wa mustaʾnafah
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which will encompass every blessing, bygone and new!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلاَةً مَرْضِيَّةً لَكَ وَلِمَنْ دُونَكَ، وَتُنْشِئُ مَعَ ذَلِكَ صَلَوَات تُضَاعِفُ مَعَهَا تِلْكَ الصَّلَوَاتِ عِنْدَهَا، وَتَزِيدُهَا عَلَى كُرُورِ الاَيَّامِ زِيَادَةً
records.transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālihī ṣalātan marḍiyyatan laka wa liman doonaka wa tunshi'u ma'a dhalika salawat tudha'ifu ma'aha tilka as-salawat 'indaha wa tazīduhā ʿalā kurūri al-ayyām ziyādah
records.english_text: Bless him and his Household with a blessing which is pleasing to Thee and everyone below Thee and will bring forth with all that a blessing with which Thou wilt multiply those blessings and increase them through the recurrence of days with an increasing

records.arabic_text: فِي تَضَاعِيفَ لاَ يَعُدُّهَا غَيْرُكَ.
records.transliteration: fi taḍāʿīf lā yaʿudduhā ghayruka
records.english_text: in multiples which none can count but Thou!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى أَطَائِبِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ الَّذِينَ اخْتَرْتَهُمْ لاَِمْرِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ خَزَنَةَ عِلْمِكَ، وَحَفَظَةَ دِيْنِكَ، وَخُلَفَآءَكَ فِي أَرْضِكَ، وَحُجَجَكَ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ،
records.transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā aṭ-ṭā’ibī ahl baytih al-ladhīna akhtartahum lāmirka wajaʿaltahu khazanata ʿil mika wa ḥafaza tadiynik wa khulafāʾaka fī arḍika, wa ḥujajaka ʿalā ʿibādika
records.english_text: My Lord, bless the best of his Household, those whom Thou hast chosen for Thy command, appointed the treasurers of Thy knowledge, the guardians of Thy religion, Thy vicegerents in Thy earth, and Thy arguments against Thy servants,

records.arabic_text: وَطَهَّرْتَهُمْ مِنَ الرِّجْسِ وَالدَّنَسِ تَطْهِيراً بِإرَادَتِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمُ الْوَسِيْلَةَ إلَيْكَ وَالْمَسْلَكَ إلَى جَنَّتِكَ،
records.transliteration: waṭahharthum mina alrijsi wa aldanas tathhiran biiradatika wa jaʿaltahumu al-wasīlata ilayka wal-maslaka ila jannatika
records.english_text: purified from uncleanness and defilement through a purification by Thy desire (ref:33:33), and made the mediation to Thee and the road to Thy Garden!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ صَلاةً تُجْزِلُ لَهُمْ بِهَا مِنْ نِحَلِكَ وَكَرَامَتِكَ، وَتُكْمِلُ لَهُمُ الاَشْيَآءَ مِنْ عَطَاياكَ وَنَوَافِلِكَ، وَتُوَفِّرُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْحَظَّ مِنْ عَوَائِدِكَ وَفَوائِدِكَ.
records.transliteration: rabbī ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih ṣalātan tuǧzilu lahum bihā min niḥalika wa karāmatika wa tukmilu lahumul-ashya'a min 'ataayika wanawafiliki wa tuwaffiru ʿalayhimu al-ḥazza min ʿawāʾidika wa fawāʾidika
records.english_text: My Lord, bless Muhammad and his Household with a blessing which makes plentiful Thy gifts and generosity, perfects for them Thy bestowals and awards, and fills out their share of Thy kindly acts and benefits!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ صَلاَةً لاَ أَمَدَ فِي أَوَّلِهَا، وَلاَ غَايَةَ لاَِمَدِهَا، وَلاَ نِهَايَةَ لاِخِرِهَا.
records.transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim ṣalātan lā amada fī awalihā walā ghāyata lā madīhā, walā nihāyata li-akhirihā
records.english_text: My Lord, bless him and his Household with a blessing whose first has no term, whose term has no limit, and whose last has no utmost end!

records.arabic_text: رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ وَمَا دُونَهُ، وَمِلءَ سَموَاتِكَ وَمَا فَوْقَهُنَّ، وَعَدَدَ أَرَضِيْكَ، وَمَا تَحْتَهُنَّ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ، صَلاَةً تُقَرِّبُهُمْ مِنْكَ زُلْفى وَتَكُونُ لَكَ وَلَهُمْ رِضَىً،
records.transliteration: rabbi ṣalli ʿalayhim zinata ʿarshika wa mā dūnah wa mil'a samawātika wa mā fawqahunna waʿadada arḍīka, wa mā taḥtahunna, wa mā baynahunna ṣalātan tuqarribuhum minka zulfa wa takūnu laka wa lahum riḍān
records.english_text: My Lord, bless them to the weight of Thy Throne and all below it, the amount that fills the heavens and all above them, the number of Thy earths and all below and between them, a blessing that will bring them near to Thee in proximity, please Thee and them,

records.arabic_text: وَمُتَّصِلَةٌ بِنَظَائِرِهِنَّ أَبَداً.
records.transliteration: wa muttaṣilatun bi-naẓāʾirihinna abadan
records.english_text: and be joined to its likes forever!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَيَّدْتَ دِينَكَ فِي كُلِّ أَوَان بِإمَام أَقَمْتَهُ عَلَماً لِعِبَادِكَ وَّمَنارَاً فِي بِلاَدِكَ، بَعْدَ أَنْ وَصَلْتَ حَبْلَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma innaka ayyadta dīnaka fī kulli awān bi'imām aqamtahu 'ilman li'ibādik wa manāran fī bilādik baʿda an waṣal-ta ḥabl-ahu bi-ḥabl-ika
records.english_text: O God, surely Thou hast confirmed Thy religion in all times with an Imam whom Thou hast set up as a guidepost to Thy servants and a lighthouse in Thy lands, after his cord has been joined to Thy cord!

records.arabic_text: وَجَعَلْتَهُ الذَّرِيعَةَ إلَى رِضْوَانِكَ، وَافْتَرَضْتَ طَاعَتَهُ، وَحَذَّرْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ، وَأَمَرْتَ بِامْتِثَالِ أوَاِمِرِه وَالانْتِهَآءِ عِنْدَ نَهْيِهِ، وَأَلاَّ يَتَقَدَّمَهُ مُتَقَدِّمٌ، وَلاَ يَتَأَخَّرَ عَنْهُ مُتَأَخِّرٌ،فَهُوَ عِصْمَةُ اللاَّئِذِينَ
records.transliteration: wajaʿaltahu al-dḥariʿah illá riḍwānika wa 'if'taradta ṭāʿatahu, wa ḥaẓẓarta maʿṣīyatuhu wa'amarta bimtithali awamirihi wal-intihai'i 'inda nahyihi wa alā yataqaddama-hu mutaqaddimun, wa lā yataʾakhkhar ʿan-hu mutaʾakhkhirun, fahuwa ʿismatu l
records.english_text: Thou hast appointed him the means to Thy good pleasure, made obeying him obligatory, cautioned against disobeying him, and commanded following his commands, abandoning what he has prohibited, and that no forward-goer go ahead of him or back-keeper keep back from him! So he is the preservation of the shelter-seekers,

records.arabic_text: ، وَكَهْفُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَعُرْوَةُ الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ، وَبَهَآءُ الْعَالَمِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa kahfu al-mu'minīn, wa ʿurwat al-mutamassikīn, wa bahāʾu al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: the cave of the faithful, the handhold of the adherents, and the radiance of the worlds!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَأَوْزِعْ لِوَلِيِّكَ شُكْرَ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَوْزِعْنَا مِثْلَهُ فِيهِ، وَآتِهِ مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَاناً نَصِيراً، وَافْتَحْ لَهُ فَتْحاً يَسِيراً، وَأَعِنْهُ بِرُكْنِكَ الاعَزِّ، وَاشْدُدْ أَزْرَهُ، وَقَوِّ عَضُدَهُ، وَرَاعِهِ بِعَيْنِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma fa'awzil liwaliyyika shukra mā an`amta bihī `alayhi wa ʾawziʿnā mithlahu fīh, wa ʾātihī min ladunka sulṭānan naṣīran waftaḥ lahū fatḥan yasīran wa-aʿin-hu bi-ruknikal aʿazz wa ashuddu azrah, wa qawwia 'adudah, wa ra'ihi bi'aynik
records.english_text: O God, so inspire Thy guardian to give thanks for that in which Thou hast favoured him, inspire us with the like concerning him, grant him 'an authority from Thee to help him' (ref.17:80), open for him an easy opening, aid him with Thy mightiest pillar, brace up his back, strengthen his arm, guard him with Thy eye,

records.arabic_text: وَاحْمِهِ بِحِفْظِكَ، وَانْصُرْهُ بِمَلائِكَتِكَ، وَامْدُدْهُ بِجُنْدِكَ الاَغْلَبِ وَأَقِمْ بِهِ كِتَابَكَ وَحُدُودَكَ، وَشَرَائِعَكَ وَسُنَنَ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ، وَأَحْيِ بِهِ مَا أَمَاتَهُ الظَّالِمُونَ مِنْ مَعَالِمِ دِينِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa'aḥmih biḥifẓika, waansurhu bimala'ikatika wa-amdudhu bi-jundika al-aǧlabi wa-aqim bihi kitabaka wa-ḥududaka wa sharāʾiʿaka wa sunan rasūlika ṣalawātuka allāhumma ʿalayhi wa ālihi wa aḥyi bihi mā amātahu aẓ-ẓālimūna min maʿālimi dīnika
records.english_text: defend him with Thy safeguarding, help him with Thy angels, and assist him with Thy most victorious troops! Through him establish Thy Book, Thy bounds, Thy laws, and the norms of Thy Messenger's Sunna (Thy blessings, O God, be upon him and his Household), bring to life the guideposts of Thy religion, deadened by the wrongdoers,

records.arabic_text: وَاجْلُ بِهِ صَدَآءَ الْجَوْرِ عَنْ طَرِيقَتِكَ، وَأَبِنْ بِهِ الضَّرَّآءَ مِنْ سَبِيلِكَ، وَأَزِلْ بِهِ النَّاكِبِينَ عَنْ صِرَاطِكَ، وَامْحَقْ بِهِ بُغَاةَ قَصْدِكَ عِوَجاً،
records.transliteration: waajlu bihi sadaa' al-jawri 'an tariqatika wa ʾabini bihi aḍ-ḍarrrā'a min sabīlika wa azil bihi annākibīna 'an ṣirātika wamḥaq bihi bughātat qaṣdika ʿiwajā
records.english_text: burnish the rust of injustice from Thy way, sift the adversity from Thy road, eliminate those who deviate from Thy path, and erase those who seek crookedness in Thy straightness!

records.arabic_text: وَأَلِنْ جَانِبَهُ لاَِوْلِيَآئِكَ، وَابْسُطْ يَدَهُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِكَ، وَهَبْ لَنا رَأْفَتَهُ وَرَحْمَتَهُ وَتَعَطُّفَهُ وَتَحَنُّنَهُ، وَاجْعَلْنَا لَهُ سَامِعِينَ مُطِيعِينَ، وَفِي رِضَاهُ سَاعِينَ، وَإلَى نُصْرَتِهِ وَالْمُدَافَعَةِ عَنْهُ مُكْنِفِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa 'alin janibahu li-awliyā'ika, wa 'absut yadahu 'ala 'a'dā'ika wahab lana ra'fatahu wa rahmatahu wa ta'attufahu wa tahannunahu wa-jaʿalna lahu sāmiʿīna muṭīʿīna, wa fī riḍāhu sāʿīna wa-ilā nuṣratihī wal-mudāfaʿah ʿanhū muknifīn
records.english_text: Make his side mild toward Thy friends, stretch forth his hand over Thy enemies, give us his clemency, his mercy, his tenderness, his sympathy, and make us his hearers and obeyers, strivers toward his good pleasure, assistants in helping him and defending him,

records.arabic_text: وَإلَيْكَ وَإلَى رَسُولِكَ صَلَواتُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ بِذَلِكَ مُتَقَرِّبِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa-ilayka wa-ilaa rasulika ṣalawaatuka allāhumma ʿalayhi wa ālihi bidhālika mutaqarrabīna.
records.english_text: and brought near through that to Thee and Thy Messenger (Thy blessings, O God, be upon him and his Household).

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى أَوْلِيآئِهِمُ الْمُعْتَرِفِينَ بِمَقَامِهِمْ، الْمُتَّبِعِينَ مَنْهَجَهُمْ، الْمُقْتَفِيْنَ آثَارَهُمْ، الْمُسْتَمْسِكِينَ بِعُرْوَتِهِمْ، الْمُتَمَسِّكِينَ بِوَلاَيَتِهِمْ، الْمُؤْتَمِّينَ بِإمَامَتِهِمْ، الْمُسَلِّمِينَ لاَِمْرِهِمْ
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa ṣalli ʿalā awliyāʾihimu al-muʿtarifīna bimaqāmihim al-mutta bi'īna manhajahum, al-muqtāfiīna āthārahum al-mustamisikiina bi-ʿurwatihim, al-mutamassikiina bi-walayatihim al-muʾtamminan bi-imāmatihim, al-muslimīn lā ʾamrihim
records.english_text: O God, and bless the friends [of the Imams], the confessors of their station, the keepers to their course, the pursuers of their tracks, the clingers to their handhold, the adherents to their guardianship, the followers of their imamate, the submitters to their command,

records.arabic_text: الْمُجْتَهِدِيْنَ فِي طاعَتِهِمْ، الْمُنْتَظِرِيْنَ أَيَّامَهُمْ، الْمَادِّينَ إلَيْهِمْ أَعْيُنَهُمْ، الصَّلَوَاتِ الْمُبَارَكَاتِ الزَّاكِيَاتِ النَّامِيَاتِ الغَادِيَاتِ، الرَّائِحاتِ.
records.transliteration: al-mujtahidīna fī ṭāʿatihim, al-muntazirīna ayyāmahum al-māddīnah ilayhim aʿyunahum al-ṣalawāt al-mubārakāt al-zākiyāt al-nāmiyāt al-ghādiyāt, al-rā'iḥāt
records.english_text: the strivers to obey them, the awaiters of their days, the directors of their eyes toward them, with blessings blessed, pure, growing, fresh, and fragrant!

records.arabic_text: وَسَلِّمْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَعَلَى أَرْوَاحِهِمْ، وَاجْمَعْ عَلَى التَّقْوَى أَمْرَهُمْ، وَأَصْلِحْ لَهُمْ شُؤُونَهُمْ، وَتُبْ عَلَيْهِمْ
records.transliteration: wa sallim ʿalayhim wa ʿala arwāhihim waajmaʿ ʿalaa altaqwaa amrahum wa asliḥ lahum shuʾūnahum wa tub ʿalayhim
records.english_text: Give them and their spirits peace, bring together their affair in reverential fear, set right their situations, turn toward them,

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ وَخَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مَعَهُمْ فِي دَارِ السَّلاَمِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
records.transliteration: innaka anta at-tawwabu ar-rahīmu wa khayru al-ghāfirīn wa-ijʿalna maʿahum fi daris-salam bi-rahmatika ya arhamar-rahimīn
records.english_text: "Surely Thou art Ever-turning, All-compassionate" (2:128) and the Best of forgivers, and place us with them in the Abode of Peace, through Thy mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ، يَوْمٌ شَرَّفْتَهُ وَكَرَّمْتَهُ وَعَظَّمْتَهُ، نَشَرْتَ فِيهِ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَمَنَنْتَ فِيهِ بِعَفْوِكَ وَأَجْزَلْتَ فِيهِ عَطِيَّتَكَ، وَتَفَضَّلْتَ بِهِ عَلَى عِبَادِكَ.
records.transliteration: allāhumma hādhā yawmu ʿarafah yawmun sharraftahu wa karramatahu wa ʿadhdhamtahu, nashartafihi rahmatika wa manantan fihi bi'afwik-a wa ajzalt-a fihi `atiyyatak-a wa tafaddal-ta bihi 'ala 'ibadik
records.english_text: O God, this is the Day of 'Arafa, a day which Thou hast made noble, given honour, and magnified. Within it Thou hast spread Thy mercy, showed kindness through Thy pardon, and made plentiful Thy giving, and by it Thou hast been bounteous toward Thy servants.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الَّذِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَبْلَ خَلْقِكَ لَهُ، وَبَعْدَ خَلْقِكَ إيَّاهُ،
records.transliteration: allahumma wa ana 'abduka alladhi an'amta 'alayhi qabla khalqika lahu, wa ba'da khalqika iyyahu
records.english_text: I am Thy servant whom Thou favoured before creating him and after creating him.

records.arabic_text: فَجَعَلْتَهُ مِمَّنْ هَدَيْتَهُ لِدِينِكَ، وَوَفَّقْتَهُ لِحَقِّكَ، وَعَصَمْتَهُ بِحَبْلِكَ، وَأَدْخَلْتَهُ فِيْ حِزْبِكَ، وَأَرْشَدْتَهُ لِمُوَالاَةِ أَوْليآئِكَ، وَمُعَادَاةِ أَعْدَائِكَ، ثُمَّ أَمَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَأْتَمِرْ،
records.transliteration: fajaʿaltahu mimmān hadaytahu lī dīnik wa waffaqtahu lihaqqika, wa ʿasamtahu bihablika wa adkhaltahu fi hizbika, wa arshadtahu limuwalaat al-awliyaa'ik wa muʿādaāti aʿdāʾika, thumma amartahu falammā yatamir
records.english_text: Thou madest him one of those whom Thou guided to Thy religion, gavest success in fulfilling Thy right, preserved through Thy cord, included within Thy party, and directed aright to befriend Thy friends and show enmity to Thine enemies. Then Thou commanded him, but he did not follow Thy commands,

records.arabic_text: وَزَجَرْتَهُ فَلَمْ يَنْزَجِرْ، وَنَهَيْتَهُ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ فَخَالَفَ أَمْرَكَ إلَى نَهْيِكَ، لاَ مُعَانَدَةً لَكَ وَلاَ اسْتِكْبَاراً عَلَيْكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-zajartahu falam yanzajir, wa-nahaytahu ʿan maʿsiyatk, fakhalafa amrak ila nahyik lā muʿānadatan laka wa lā istikbāran ʿalayk
records.english_text: Thou restricted Him, but he did not heed Thy restrictions, Thou prohibited him from disobedience toward Thee, but he broke Thy command by doing what Thou hadst prohibited, not in contention with Thee, nor to display pride toward Thee;

records.arabic_text: بَلْ دَعَاهُ هَوَاهُ إلَى مَا زَيَّلْتَهُ، وَإلَى مَا حَذَّرْتَهُ، وَأَعَانَهُ عَلَى ذالِكَ عَدُوُّكَ وَعَدُوُّهُ،
records.transliteration: bal daʿāhu hawāhu ilā mā zayyaltahu wa-ilā mā ḥaḏḏartahu wa'aʿānahū ʿalā dhālika ʿaduwwuka wa ʿaduwwuhu
records.english_text: on the contrary, his caprice called him to that which Thou hadst set apart and cautioned against, and he was helped in that by Thy enemy and his enemy.

records.arabic_text: فَأَقْدَمَ عَلَيْهِ عَارِفاً بِوَعِيْدِكَ، رَاجِياً لِعَفْوِكَ، وَاثِقاً بِتَجَاوُزِكَ، وَكَانَ أَحَقَّ عِبَادِكَ ـ مَعَ مَا مَنَنْتَ عَلَيْهِ ـ أَلاَّ يَفْعَلَ،
records.transliteration: fa'aqdamah ʿalayhi ʿaarifan bi-waʿiidika, raji'an li-ʿafwik waāthiqan bi-tajāwuzika, wa kāna aḥaqqa ʿibādika maʿa manantan ʿalayhi, ʾalā yafʿal
records.english_text: So he went ahead with it knowing Thy threat, hoping for Thy pardon, and relying upon Thy forbearance, though he was the most obligated of Thy servants - given Thy kindness toward him - not to do so.

records.arabic_text: وَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ صَاغِراً، ذَلِيلاً، خَاضِعَاً، خَاشِعاً، خَائِفَاً، مُعْتَرِفاً بِعَظِيم مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ تَحَمَّلْتُهُ، وَجَلِيْل مِنَ الْخَطَايَا اجْتَرَمْتُهُ،
records.transliteration: wa-ha-a-na dhaa bayna yadayka saaghiran ẓalīlan, khāḍiʿan, khāshiʿan, khāʾifan muʿtarifan biʿaẓīmin mina aldhunūbi taḥammaltuhu wa jalil min al-khataaya ajtaramtuhu
records.english_text: Here I am, then, before Thee, despised, lowly, humble, abject, fearful, confessing the dreadful sins with which I am burdened and the great offenses that I have committed,

records.arabic_text: مُسْتَجِيراً بِصَفْحِكَ، لائِذاً بِرَحْمَتِكَ، مُوقِناً أَنَّهُ لاَ يُجِيرُنِي مِنْكَ مُجِيرٌ، وَلاَ يَمْنَعُنِي مِنْكَ مَانِعٌ .
records.transliteration: mustajīran bi-ṣafḥika, lā’iḏan bi-raḥmatika muqinan annahu la yujiruni minka mujeerun wa lā yamnaʿunī minka māniʿ
records.english_text: seeking sanctuary in Thy forgiveness, asking shelter in Thy mercy, and certain that no sanctuary-giver will give me sanctuary from Thee and no withholder will hold me back from Thee.

records.arabic_text: فَعُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَعُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنِ اقْتَرَفَ مِنْ تَغَمُّدِكَ، وَجُدْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا تَجُودُ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَلْقَى بِيَدِهِ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ، وَامْنُنْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا لاَ يَتَعَاظَمُكَ أَنْ تَمُنَّ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ أَمَّلَكَ مِنْ غُفْرَانِكَ،
records.transliteration: faʿud ʿalayya bima taʿudu bihi ʿala mani iqtarafa min taghammudika wa juud 'alayya bimā tajūdu bihī 'alā man 'alqā biyadihī 'ilayka min 'afwik wa-amnun ʿalayya bimā lā yataʿāẓamu-ka an tamunna bihi ʿalā man ammalaka min ghufraanika
records.english_text: So act kindly toward me, just as Thou actest kindly by Thy shielding him who commits sins, be munificent toward me, just as Thou art munificent by pardoning him who throws himself before Thee, and show kindness to me, just as it is nothing great for Thee to show kindness by forgiving him who expectantly hopes in Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِي فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ نَصِيباً أَنَالُ بِهِ حَظّاً مِنْ رِضْوَانِكَ، وَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي صِفْراً مِمَّا يَنْقَلِبُ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدُونَ لَكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-jaʿal li fī hādhā al-yawm naṣīban anālu bihi ḥaẓẓan min riḍwānik wa lā taruddanī ṣifran mimmā yanqalibu bihi al-mutaʿabbidūna laka min ʿibādik.
records.english_text: Appoint for me in this day an allotment through which I may attain a share of Thy good pleasure, and send me not back destitute of that with which Thy worshipers return from among Thy servants!

records.arabic_text: وَإنِّي وَإنْ لَمْ أُقَدِّمْ مَا قَدَّمُوهُ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ، فَقَد قَدَّمْتُ تَوْحِيدَكَ، وَنَفْيَ الاَضْدَادِ وَالاَنْدَادِ وَالاشْبَاهِ عَنْكَ، وَأَتَيْتُكَ مِنَ الاَبْوَابِ الَّتِي أَمَرْتَ أَنْ تُؤْتى مِنْها،
records.transliteration: wa-innī wa-in lam uqaddim mā qaddamūhu mina al-ṣāliḥāt faqad qaddamtu tawḥīdaka wa nafiya al-adad wa al-andad wa al-ashbah ʿanka wa ʾataytu-ka mina al-abwābi allatī ʾamarta ʾan tuʾta minhā
records.english_text: Though I have not forwarded the righteous deeds which they have forwarded, I have forwarded the profession of Thy Unity and the negation from Thee of opposites, rivals, and likenesses, I have come to Thee by the gateways by which Thou hast commanded that people come,

records.arabic_text: وَتَقَرَّبْتُ إلَيْكَ بِمَا لاَ يَقْرُبُ ، أَحَدٌ مِنْكَ إلاَّ بِالتَّقَرُّبِ بِهِ
records.transliteration: wa taqarrabtu ilayka bima la yaqrubu ʾaḥadun minka illā bit-taqarrub bih
records.english_text: and I have sought nearness to Thee through that, without seeking nearness through which, none gains nearness to Thee.

records.arabic_text: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعْتُ ذلِكَ بِالاِنابَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَالتَّذَلُّلِ وَالاسْتِكَانَةِ لَكَ، وَحُسْنِ الظَّنِّ بِكَ، وَالثِّقَةِ بِمَا عِنْدَكَ،
records.transliteration: thumma attabaʿtu dhalika bil-inabati ilayka wa al-tazallul wa al-istikānaẗi laka, wa ḥusni al-żann bi-ka, wa al-ṯiqāẗi bi-mā ʿind
records.english_text: Then I followed all this with repeated turning toward Thee, lowliness and abasement before Thee, good opinion of Thee, and trust in what is with Thee;

records.arabic_text: وَشَفَعْتُهُ بِرَجآئِكَ الَّذِي قَلَّ مَا يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ رَاجِيْكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-shafaʿtuhu bi-rajāʾika al-ladhi qalla ma yakhību ʿalayhi rājīk
records.english_text: and to that I coupled hope in Thee, since the one who hopes in Thee is seldom disappointed!

records.arabic_text: وَسَأَلْتُكَ مَسْأَلَةَ الْحَقِيرِ الذّلِيلِ الْبَائِسِ الْفَقِيْرِ الْخَائِفِ الْمُسْتَجِيرِ،
records.transliteration: wa saʾaltuka masʾalata al-ḥaqīri al-dḫalīl al-bāʾisi al-faqīri al-khāʾifi al-mustajīri
records.english_text: I asked Thee with the asking of one vile, lowly, pitiful, poor, fearful, seeking sanctuary;

records.arabic_text: وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ خِيفَةً وَتَضَرُّعاً وَتَعَوُّذاً وَتَلَوُّذاً، لاَ مُسْتَطِيلاً بِتَكبُّرِ الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ، وَلاَ مُتَعَالِياً بِدالَّةِ الْمُطِيعِينَ، وَلاَ مُسْتَطِيلاً بِشَفَاعَةِ الشَّافِعِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa maʿa dhalika khīfatan wa taḍarruʿan wa taʿawwudhan wa talawwuḏan lā mustaṭīlan bi takabburi al-mutakabbirīn walā mutaʿālīyan bidallati al-muṭīʿīn walā mustaṭīlan bi-shafāʿati sh-shāfiʿīn
records.english_text: all that in fear and pleading, seeking refuge and asking shelter, not presumptuous through the pride of the proud, nor exalting myself with the boldness of the obedient, nor presumptuous of the intercession of the interceders.

records.arabic_text: وَأَنَا بَعْدُ أَقَلُّ الاَقَلِّيْنَ، وَأَذَلُّ الاَذَلِّينَ، وَمِثْلُ الذَّرَّةِ أَوْ دُونَهَا.
records.transliteration: wa ana baʿdu aqallu al-aqallin, wa adhallu al-adhallin wa mithlu aldharrati awdunaha
records.english_text: For I am still the least of the least and the lowliest of the lowly, like a dust mote or less!

records.arabic_text: فَيَا مَنْ لَمْ يَعَاجِلِ الْمُسِيئِينَ، وَلاَ يَنْدَهُ الْمُتْرَفِينَ،
records.transliteration: fayā man lam yaʿājili al-musīʾīna, walā yandahū al-mutrāfīna
records.english_text: O He who does not hurry the evildoers nor restrain those living in ease!

records.arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَمُنُّ بِإقَالَةِ الْعَاثِرِينَ، وَيَتَفَضَّلُ بإنْظَارِ الْخَاطِئِينَ،
records.transliteration: wayā man yamunnu bi-iqālati al-ʿāthirīna, wa yatafaḍḍalu bi-inẓāri al-khāṭiʾ
records.english_text: O He who shows kindness through releasing the stumblers and gratuitous bounty through respiting the offenders!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الْمُسِيءُ الْمُعْتَرِفُ الْخَاطِئُ الْعَاثِرُ،
records.transliteration: ana al-musii'u al-mu'tarifu al-khaati'u al-aathiru
records.english_text: I am the evildoer, the confessor, the offender, the stumbler!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِيْ أَقْدَمَ عَلَيْكَ مُجْتَرِئاً،
records.transliteration: ana alladhī aqdamu ʿalayka mujtarīʾan
records.english_text: I am he who was audacious toward Thee as one insolent!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي عَصَاكَ مُتَعَمِّداً،
records.transliteration: anā alladhī ʿaṣāka mutaʿammidan
records.english_text: I am he who disobeyed Thee with forethought!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي اسْتَخْفى مِنْ عِبَادِكَ وَبَارَزَكَ،
records.transliteration: anā alladhī astakhfā min ʿibādika wa bārazaka
records.english_text: I am he who hid myself from Thy servants and blatantly showed myself to Thee!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي هَابَ عِبَادَكَ وَأَمِنَكَ
records.transliteration: anā alladhī hāba ʿibādaka wa aminka
records.english_text: I am he who was awed by Thy servants and felt secure from Thee!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الَّذِي لَمْ يَرْهَبْ سَطْوَتَكَ وَلَمْ يَخَفْ بَأْسَكَ
records.transliteration: anā alladhī lam yarhab saṭwatka wa lam yakhaf basaka
records.english_text: I am he who dreaded not Thy penalty and feared not Thy severity!

records.arabic_text: أَنَا الْجَانِي عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، أَنَا الْمُرْتَهَنُ بِبَلِيَّتِهِ،
records.transliteration: ana al-jani `ala nafsihi, ana al-murtahanu bi-baliyyatihi
records.english_text: I am the offender against himself! I am the hostage to his own affliction!

records.arabic_text: الْقَلِيلُ الْحَيَاءِ، أَنَا الطَّوِيلُ الْعَنآءِ،
records.transliteration: al-qalīlu al-ḥayāʾi, anā al-ṭawīlu al-ʿanāʾi
records.english_text: I am short in shame! I am long in suffering!

records.arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ انْتَجَبْتَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِمَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَهُ لِنَفْسِكَ،
records.transliteration: biḥaqqi mani intajabta min khalkika wa bimani-stafaytahu li nafsika
records.english_text: By the right of him whom Thou hast distinguished among Thy creation and by him whom Thou hast chosen for Thyself!

records.arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنِ اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ بَريَّتِكَ، وَمَنِ اجْتَبَيْتَ لِشَأْنِكَ،
records.transliteration: biḥaqqi mani ikhtartamin barīyatika, wa mani ijtabayta li-shaʾnik
records.english_text: By the right of him whom Thou hast selected from among Thy creatures and by him whom Thou hast picked for Thy task!

records.arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ وَصَلْتَ طَاعَتَهُ بِطَاعَتِكَ، وَمَنْ جَعَلْتَ مَعْصِيَتَهُ كَمَعْصِيَتِكَ
records.transliteration: biḥaqqi man waṣaltat ṭāʿatahu biṭāʿatika wa-man jaʿalta maʿsiyatahu kamaʿsiyatika
records.english_text: By the right of him the obeying of whom Thou hast joined to obeying Thee, and by him the disobeying of whom Thou hast made like disobeying Thee!

records.arabic_text: بِحَقِّ مَنْ قَرَنْتَ مُوَالاَتَهُ بِمُوالاتِكَ، وَمَنْ نُطْتَ مُعَادَاتَهُ بِمُعَادَاتِكَ.
records.transliteration: biḥaqqi man qaranta muwālātahu bimuwālatika wa man nutta muʿaadatuhu bimuʿaadatika
records.english_text: And by the right of him whose friendship Thou hast bound to Thy friendship and by him whose enmity Thou hast linked to Thine enmity!

records.arabic_text: تَغَمَّدْنِي فِي يَوْمِيَ هَذَا بِمَا تَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ جَارَ إلَيْكَ مُتَنَصِّلاً، وَعَاذَ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ تَائِباً،
records.transliteration: taghammadnī fī yawmiya hādhā bimā tataghammadu bihi man jāra ilayka mutanasṣilan waʿāḏa bi-istighfārika tāʾiban
records.english_text: Shield me in this day of mine, by that through which Thou shieldest him who prays fervently to Thee while disavowing and him who seeks refuge in Thy forgiveness while repenting!

records.arabic_text: وَتَوَلَّنِي بِمَا تَتَوَلَّى بِهِ أَهْلَ طَاعَتِكَ، وَالزُّلْفَى لَدَيْكَ، وَالْمَكَانَةِ مِنْكَ،
records.transliteration: wa tawallanī bimā tatawallā bihi ahl ṭāʿatika wa al-zulfā ladayka, wa al-makānatu minka
records.english_text: Attend to me with that through which Thou attendest to the people of obedience toward Thee, proximity to Thee, and rank with Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَتَوَحَّدْنِي بِمَا تَتَوَحَّدُ بِهِ مَنْ وَفى بِعَهْدِكَ، وَأَتْعَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِيْ ذَاتِكَ، وَأَجْهَدَهَا فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa tawaḥhadnī bimā tatawaḥhadu bihī man wafā bi'ahdika wa-at'aba nafsahu fi dhatika, wa-ajhadaha fi marzatika
records.english_text: Single me out, as Thou singlest him out who fulfils Thy covenant, fatigues himself for Thy sake alone, and exerts himself in Thy good pleasure!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِتَفْرِيطِيْ فِي جَنْبِكَ، وَتَعَدِّي طَوْرِيْ فِي حُدودِكَ، وَمُجَاوَزَةِ أَحْكَامِكَ.
records.transliteration: walā tuʾākhidhnī bi tafritī fī janbik wa taʿaddi ṭawrī fī ḥudūdika, wa mujāwazati aḥkāmika
records.english_text: Take me not to task for my neglect in respect to Thee, my transgressing the limit in Thy bounds, and stepping outside Thy ordinances!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسْتَدْرِجْنِي بِإمْلائِكَ لِي اسْتِدْرَاجَ مَنْ مَنَعَنِي خَيْرَ مَا عِنْدَهُ، وَلَمْ يَشْرَكْكَ فِي حُلُولِ نِعْمَتِهِ بِي،
records.transliteration: wa lā tastadrijnī bi-imlā'ika lī istidrājaman manaʿanī khayra mā ʿindahu walammashrakkaka fee hulooli ni'matih biy
records.english_text: Draw me not on little by little by granting me a respite, like the drawing on little by little of him who withholds from me the good he has by not sharing with Thee in letting favour down upon me!

records.arabic_text: وَنَبِّهْنِي مِنْ رَقْدَةِ الْغَافِلِينَ، وَسِنَةِ الْمُسْرِفِينَ، وَنَعْسَةِ الْمَخْذُولِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa nabbihni min raqdah al-ghafilin wa sinati al-musrifin, wa na'sati al-makhdhulīn
records.english_text: Arouse me from the sleep of the heedless, the slumber of the prodigal, and the dozing of the forsaken!

records.arabic_text: وَخُذْ بِقَلْبِي إلَى مَا اسْتَعْمَلْتَ بِهِ القَانِتِيْنَ، وَاسْتَعْبَدْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَعَبِّدِينَ، وَاسْتَنْقَذْتَ بِهِ الْمُتَهَاوِنِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa khudh biqalbi ila ma astaʿmalt bihi al-qanitīn wa astaʿbadta bihi al-mutaʿabbideen, wa istanqadhta bihi al-mutahawineen
records.english_text: Take my heart to that in which Thou hast employed the devout, enthralled the worshipers, and rescued the remiss!

records.arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي مِمَّا يُبَاعِدُنِي عَنْكَ، وَيَحُولُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ حَظِّي مِنْكَ، وَيَصُدُّنِي عَمَّا أُحَاوِلُ لَدَيْكَ.
records.transliteration: wa'a'ithni mimma yuba'iiduni 'anka wayaḥūlu baynī wa bayna ḥaẓẓī minka wa yasuddunī ʿammā uḥāwilu ladayka
records.english_text: Give me refuge from that which will keep me far from Thee, come between me and my share from Thee, and bar me from that which I strive for in Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَسَهِّلْ لِي مَسْلَكَ الْخَيْرَاتِ إلَيْكَ، وَالْمُسَابَقَةِ إلَيْهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتَ، وَالْمُشَاحَّةَ فِيهَا عَلَى مَا أَرَدْتَ.
records.transliteration: wasahhil li maslakal khayrati ilayk wal-musābaqati ilayhā min ḥaythu amarta wal-mushāḥḥata fīhā ʿalā mā aradta
records.english_text: Make easy for me the road of good deeds toward Thee, racing to them from where Thou hast commanded, and coveting them as Thou desirest!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْحَقْنِي فِيمَنْ تَمْحَقُ مِنَ الْمُسْتَخِفِّينَ بِمَا أَوْعَدْتَ،
records.transliteration: walā tamḥaqnī fīman tamḥaq min al-mustaḫiffīna bimā awʿadta
records.english_text: Efface me not along with those whom Thou effacest for thinking lightly of what Thou hast promised!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي مَعَ مَنْ تُهْلِكُ مِنَ الْمُتَعَرِّضِينَ لِمَقْتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa lā tuhliknī maʿa man tuhliku min al-mutaʿarridīna li-maqtika
records.english_text: Destroy me not with those whom Thou destroyest for exposing themselves to Thy hate!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُتَبِّرْني فِيمَنْ تُتَبِّرُ مِنَ الْمُنْحَرِفِينَ عَنْ سُبُلِكَ.
records.transliteration: walā tutabbirnī fīman tutabbiru minal munḥarifīna ʿan subulika
records.english_text: Annihilate me not among those whom Thou annihilatest for deviating from Thy roads!

records.arabic_text: وَنَجِّنِيْ مِنْ غَمَرَاتِ الْفِتْنَةِ، وَخَلِّصْنِي مِنْ لَهَوَاتِ الْبَلْوى، وَأَجِرْنِي مِنْ أَخْذِ الاِمْلاءِ،
records.transliteration: wa najjinī min ghamarātil fitnah wa khal-lis-ni min lahawatil balwaa waajirnii min akhẓi al-imlaa'i
records.english_text: Deliver me from the floods of trial, save me from the gullets of affliction, and grant me sanctuary from being seized by respite!

records.arabic_text: وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عَدُوٍّ يُضِلُّنِي، وَهَوىً يُوبِقُنِي، وَمَنْقَصَة تَرْهَقُنِي.
records.transliteration: wa ḥul bayni wa bayna ʿaduwwin yuḍillunī wa hawān yūbiqunī, wa manqasah tarhiqunī
records.english_text: Come between me and the enemy who misguides me, the caprice which ruins me, and the failing which overcomes me!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُعْرِضْ عَنِّي إعْرَاضَ مَنْ لاَ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بَعْدَ غَضَبِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa lā tuʿriḍ ʿannī iʿrāḍa man lā tarḍā ʿanhu baʿda ghaḍabika
records.english_text: Turn not away from me with the turning away in wrath from one with whom Thou art not pleased!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُؤْيِسْنِي مِنَ الامَلِ فِيكَ، فَيَغْلِبَ عَلَيَّ الْقُنُوطُ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā tuʾayyisnī min al-amal fīka, fayaghliba ʿalayya al-qunūṭu min raḥmatika
records.english_text: Let me not lose heart in expecting from Thee, lest I be overcome by despair of Thy mercy!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْنَحْنِي بِمَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لِيْ بِهِ، فَتَبْهَظَنِي مِمَّا تُحَمِّلُنِيهِ مِنْ فَضْلِ مَحَبَّتِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā tamnaḥnī bimā lā ṭāqata lī bihī fatabhazhanī mimmā tuḥammilunīhi min faḍli maḥabbatika
records.english_text: Grant me not that which I cannot endure, lest Thou weighest me down with the surplus of Thy love which Thou loadest upon me!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُرْسِلْنِي مِنْ يَدِكَ إرْسَالَ مَنْ لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهِ، وَلاَ حَاجَةَ بِكَ إلَيْهِ، وَلاَ إنابَةَ لَهُ،
records.transliteration: walā tur-silnī min yadika ir-sāla man lā khayra fīhī wa-lā ḥājata bika ʾilayhi, wa-lā inābata lah
records.english_text: Send me not from Thy hand, the sending of him who possesses no good, toward whom Thou hast no need, and who turns not back [to Thee]!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرْمِ بِيَ رَمْيَ مَنْ سَقَطَ مِنْ عَيْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَمَنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْخِزْيُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā tarmi biya ramya man saqata min ʿayni riʿāyatika wa mani ashtamala ʿalayhi al-khizyu min ʿindika
records.english_text: Cast me not with the casting of him who has fallen from the eye of Thy regard and been wrapped in degradation from Thee!

records.arabic_text: بَلْ خُذْ بِيَدِيْ مِنْ سَقْطَةِ الْمُتَرَدِّدِينَ، وَوَهْلَةِ الْمُتَعَسِّفِيْنَ، وَزَلّةِ الْمَغْرُورِينَ، وَوَرْطَةِ الْهَالِكِينَ.
records.transliteration: bal khudh biyadi min saqţati almutaraddidin wa wahlati al-mutaʿassisfiin, wa zallati al-maghruuriin, wa wartaṭati al-haalikiin
records.english_text: Rather take my hand [and save me] from the falling of the stumblers, the disquiet of the deviators, the slip of those deluded, and the plight of the perishers!

records.arabic_text: وَعَافِنِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَيْتَ بِهِ طَبَقَاتِ عَبِيدِكَ وَإمآئِكَ، وَبَلِّغْنِي مَبَالِغَ مَنْ عُنِيتَ بِهِ، وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَرَضِيتَ عَنْهُ، فَأَعَشْتَهُ حَمِيداً، وَتَوَفَّيْتَهُ سَعِيداً،
records.transliteration: wa'aafini mimma ibtalayta bihi ṭabaqāti ʿibādika wa imā'ika wa ballighnī mabāligha man ʿunīta bihī, wa anʿamta ʿalayhī, wa raḍīta ʿanhu fa'aʿashtahu ḥamīdan, wa tawaffaytahu saʿīdan
records.english_text: Release me from that with which Thou hast afflicted the ranks of Thy servants and handmaids and make me reach the utmost degrees of him about whom Thou art concerned, towards whom Thou showest favour, and with whom Thou art pleased, so that Thou lettest him live as one praiseworthy and takest him to Thee as one felicitous!

records.arabic_text: وَطَوِّقْنِي طَوْقَ الاِقْلاَعِ عَمَّا يُحْبِطُ الْحَسَنَاتِ، وَيَذْهَبُ بِالْبَرَكَاتِ،
records.transliteration: wa ṭawwiq-nī ṭawq al-iqlāʿ ʿammā yuḥbiṭu al-ḥasanāt wayadhhabu bil-barakāti
records.english_text: Collar me with the collar of abstaining from that which makes good deeds fail and takes away blessings!

records.arabic_text: وَأَشْعِرْ قَلْبِيَ الازْدِجَارَ عَنْ قَبَائِحِ السَّيِّئاتِ، وَفَوَاضِحِ الْحَوْبَاتِ،
records.transliteration: wa-ashʿir qalbiya al-azdijara ʿan qaba'ihis sayyi'at wafawāḍiḥi al-ḥawbāt
records.english_text: Impart to my heart restraint before ugly works of evil and disgraceful misdeeds!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَشْغَلْنِي بِمَا لاَ أُدْرِكُهُ إلاَّ بِكَ عَمَّا لا َ يُرْضِيْكَ عَنِّي غَيْرُهُ،
records.transliteration: walā tašġalnī bimā lā udriku-hu illā bika, ʿammā lā yurḍīka ʿannī ġayru-hu
records.english_text: Divert me not by that which I cannot reach except through Thee from doing that which alone makes Thee pleased with me!

records.arabic_text: وَانْزَعْ مِنْ قَلْبِي حُبَّ دُنْيَا دَنِيَّة تَنْهى عَمَّا عِنْدَكَ، وَتَصُدُّ عَنِ ابْتِغَآءِ الْوَسِيلَةِ إلَيْكَ، وَتُذْهِلُ عَنِ التَّقَرُبِ مِنْكَ،
records.transliteration: wa anzʿa min qalbī ḥubba dunyā dunyātan tuhannī ʿammā ʿindaka wa taṣuddu ʿani ibtiġāʾi al-wasīlah ilayka, wa tudh-hilu ʿani al-taqarrub minak
records.english_text: Root out from my heart the love of this vile world, which keeps from everything which is with Thee, bars from seeking the mediation to Thee, and distracts from striving for nearness to Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَزَيِّنَ لِيَ التَّفَرُّدَ بِمُنَاجَاتِكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ،
records.transliteration: wa zayyina liya at-tafarruda bimunajatika billayli wan-nahari
records.english_text: Embellish for me solitude in prayer whispered to Thee by night and by day!

records.arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي عِصْمَةً تُدْنِينِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَتَقْطَعُنِي عَنْ رُكُوبِ مَحَارِمكَ، وَتَفُكُّنِي مِنْ أَسْرِ الْعَظَائِمِ،
records.transliteration: wa hab li ʿismatan tudnini min khashyatika wa taqṭaʿunī ʿan rukūbi mahārimika wa tafukkuni min asri l-'adha'im
records.english_text: Give me a preservation which will bring me close to dread of Thee, cut me off from committing things made unlawful by Thee, and spare me from captivation by dreadful sins!

records.arabic_text: وَهَبْ لِي التَّطْهِيرَ مِنْ دَنَسِ الْعِصْيَانِ، وَأَذْهِبْ عَنِّي دَرَنَ الْخَطَايَا، وَسَرْبِلْنِي بِسِرْبالِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَرَدِّنِي رِدَآءَ مُعَافاتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa hab li al-tat'hīr min danas al-'iṣyān wa-adhhib ʿanni darana al-khataaya wa sarbilni bisirbal `afiyyatika waraddini ridā'a mu'āfātika
records.english_text: Give me purification from the defilement of disobedience, take away from me the filth of offenses, dress me in the dress of Thy well-being, cloak me in the cloak of Thy release,

records.arabic_text: وَجَلِّلْنِي سَوابِغَ نَعْمَائِكَ، وَظَاهِرْ لَدَيَّ فَضْلَكَ وَطَوْلَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa jalilni sawabigha na'ma'ik waẓāhir ladayya faḍlaka wa ṭawlaka
records.english_text: wrap me in Thy ample favours, and clothe me in Thy bounty and Thy graciousness!

records.arabic_text: وَأَيْدْنِي بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَتَسْدِيْدِكَ، وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى صالِحِ النِّيَّةِ وَمَرْضِيِّ الْقَوْلِ وَمُسْتَحْسَنِ الْعَمَلِ.
records.transliteration: waʾaydnī bi tawfīqika wa tasdīdika wa'a`inni `ala ṣāliḥi al-niyyah wa marḍiyyi al-qawl wa mustaḥsani al-`amal
records.english_text: Strengthen me with Thy giving success and Thy pointing the right way, help me toward righteous intention, pleasing words, and approved works,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إلَى حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي دُونَ حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa lā takilnī ilā ḥawlī wa quwwatī dūna ḥawlik wa quwwatik
records.english_text: and entrust me not to my force and my strength in place of Thy force and Thy strength!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَخْزِنِي يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُنِي لِلِقائِكَ، وَلاَ تَفْضَحْنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْ أَوْلِياِئكَ، وَلاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَكَ، وَلاَ تُذْهِبْ عَنِّي شُكْرَكَ، بَلْ أَلْزِمْنِيهِ فِي أَحْوَالِ السَّهْوِ عِنْدَ غَفَلاَتِ الْجَاهِلِينَ لاِلائِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā takhzinī yawma tabʿathunī lilqāʾika walā tafḍaḥnī bayna yaday awliyā'ika walā tunsinī dhikrak, walā tudhhib 'annī shukrak bal alzimniihi fi aḥwaali alssahwi ʿinda ghafalati aljāhiliyna lailāka
records.english_text: Degrade me not on the day Thou raisest me up to meet Thee, disgrace me not before Thy friends, make me not forget remembering Thee, take not away from me thanking Thee, but enjoin it upon me in states of inattention when the ignorant are heedless of Thy boons,

records.arabic_text: وَأَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أُثْنِيَ بِمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِيهِ، وَأَعْتَرِفِ بِمَا أَسْدَيْتَهُ إلَيَّ،
records.transliteration: wa-awziʿnī an uthniya bimā awlaytanīh wa'a'tarifu bima asdaytahu ilayya
records.english_text: and inspire me to laud what Thou hast done for me and confess to what Thou hast conferred upon me!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِي إلَيْكَ فَوْقَ رَغْبَةِ الْرَّاغِبِينَ، وَحَمْدِي إيَّاكَ فَوْقَ حَمْدِ الْحَامِدِيْنَ،
records.transliteration: wajʿal raghbatī ilayka fawqa raghbatil-rāghibīn wa ḥamdī iyyāka fawqa ḥamdi al-ḥāmidīn
records.english_text: Place my beseeching Thee above the beseeching of the beseechers and my praise of Thee above the praise of the praisers!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي عِنْدَ فاقَتِي إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي بِمَا أَسْدَيْتُهُ إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تَجْبَهْنِي بِمَا جَبَهْتَ بِهِ لْمَعَانِدِينَ لَكَ، فَإنِّي لَكَ مُسَلِّمٌ، أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الْحُجَّةَ لَكَ،
records.transliteration: wa lā takhẓulnī ʿinda faqatī ʾilayk walā tuhlíknī bimā asdaytuhu ʾilayk wa la tajbahni bima jabahta bihi lima'anidin laka fa inni laka muslimun, aʿlamu anna al-hujjata laka
records.english_text: Abandon me not with my neediness for Thee, destroy me not for what I have done for Thee, and slap not my brow with that with which Thou slappest the brow of those who contend with Thee, for I am submitted to Thee. I know that the argument is Thine,

records.arabic_text: وَأَنَّكَ أَوْلَى بِالْفَضْلِ، وَأَعْوَدُ بِالاحْسَانِ، وَأَهْلُ التَّقْوَى، وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَأَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَعْفُوَ أَوْلَى مِنْكَ بِأَنْ تُعَاقِبَ، وَأَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَسْتُرَ أَقْرَبُ مِنْكَ إلَى أنْ تَشْهَرَ،
records.transliteration: wa-annaka a'wla bil-fadli, wa-a'wadu bil-ihsani wa-aahl al-taqwá, wa-aahl al-maghfirah wa-annaka bi-an taʿfuwa aula minaka bi-an tuʿaqiba wa-annaka bi-an tastura aqrabu minka ila an tashhara
records.english_text: that Thou art closest to bounty, most accustomed to beneficence, "worthy of reverent fear, and worthy of forgiveness" (75:56), that Thou art closer to pardoning than to punishing, and that Thou art nearer to covering over than to making notorious!

records.arabic_text: فَأَحْيِنِي حَياةً طَيِّبَةً تَنْتَظِمُ بِما أُرِيدُ وَتَبْلُغُ مَا أُحِبُّ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ آتِي مَا تَكْرَهُ وَلاَ أَرْتَكِبُ مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ،
records.transliteration: fa'ahyini hayatan tayyibatan tantazimu bima uridu wa tablughu ma uhibbu min haythu la ati ma takrah wa lā ʾartakibu mā nahayta ʿanhu
records.english_text: Let me live an agreeable life that will tie together what I want and reach what I love while I not bring what Thou dislikest and not commit what Thou hast prohibited;

records.arabic_text: وَأَمِتْنِي مِيْتَةَ مَنْ يَسْعَى نُورُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَعَنْ يِمِيِنهِ،
records.transliteration: wa amitni mītata man yasʿā nūruhu bayna yadayhi, wa ʿan yimīnih
records.english_text: and make me die the death of him whose light runs before him and on his right hand!

records.arabic_text: وَذَلِّلْنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَأَعِزَّنِيْ عِنْدَ خَلْقِكَ، وَضَعْنِي إذَا خَلَوْتُ بِكَ، وَارْفَعْنِي بَيْنَ عِبادِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي عَمَّنْ هُوَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّي، وَزِدْنِي إلَيْكَ فَاقَةً وَفَقْراً،
records.transliteration: wadhallilni bayna yadayka, wa a'izzani 'indaka waḍaʿnī idhā khalawtu bika, wa-arfaʿnī bayna ʿibādika wa-aghneeni ʿamman huwa ghaniyyun ʿanni wa-zidni ilayka faqatan wa faqrā
records.english_text: Abase me before Thyself and exalt me before Thy creatures, lower me when I am alone with Thee and raise me among Thy servants, free me from need for him who has no need of me and increase me in neediness and poverty toward Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الاَعْدَاءِ، وَمِنْ حُلُولِ الْبَلاءِ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ وَالْعَنَآءِ،
records.transliteration: wa'aʿidhni min shamātati al-aʿdāʾi wa min ḥulūlil-balāʾi, wa minal-ḏulli wal-ʿanāʾi
records.english_text: Give me refuge from the gloating of enemies, the arrival of affliction, lowliness and suffering!

records.arabic_text: تَغَمَّدني فِيمَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى الْبَطْشِ لَوْلاَ حِلْمُهُ، وَالاخِذُ عَلَى الْجَرِيرَةِ لَوْلاَ أَناتُهُ،
records.transliteration: taghammadnī fīmā aṭṭalʿaʿtā ʿalayhi minnī bimā yataghammadu bih al-qādiru ʿalā al-baṭshi lawlā ḥilmuhu wa al-akhidhu ʿalā al-jarīrah, lawlā anātuhu
records.english_text: Shield me in what Thou seest from me, the shielding of him who would have power over violence had he no clemency, and would seize for misdeeds had he no lack of haste!

records.arabic_text: وَإذَا أَرَدْتَ بِقَوْم فِتْنَةً أَوْ سُوءً فَنَجِّنِي مِنْهَا لِواذاً بِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-idha aradta biqawmin fitnatan aw su'an fanajjini minha li-wadhankan bi-ka
records.english_text: When Thou desirest for a people a trial or an evil, deliver me from it, for I seek Thy shelter;

records.arabic_text: وَإذْ لَمْ تُقِمْنِي مَقَامَ فَضِيحَة فِي دُنْيَاكَ فَلاَ تُقِمْنِي مِثْلَهُ فِيْ آخِرَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-idh lam tuqimni maqaman fadhihah fi dunyaka fala tuqimni mithlahu fi akhiratika
records.english_text: and since Thou hast not stood me in the station of disgrace in this world of Thine, stand me not in such a station in the next world of Thine!

records.arabic_text: وَاشْفَعْ لِي أَوَائِلَ مِنَنِكَ بِأَوَاخِرِهَا، وَقَدِيمَ فَوَائِدِكَ بِحَوَادِثِهَا.
records.transliteration: wašfaʿ li ʾawāʾila minnik biʾawāḫirihā waqadīma fawāʾidika biḥawādithihā
records.english_text: Couple for me the beginnings of Thy kindnesses with their ends and the ancient of Thy benefits with the freshly risen!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْدُدْ لِيَ مَدّاً يَقْسُو مَعَهُ قَلْبِي،
records.transliteration: walā tamdud liya maddan yaqsu maʿahu qalbī
records.english_text: Prolong not my term with a prolonging through which my heart will harden!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَقْرَعْنِي قَارِعَةً يَذْهَبُ لَها بَهَآئِي،
records.transliteration: wa lā taqraʿnī qāriʿatan yaẓhabu lahā bahāʾī
records.english_text: Strike me not with a striking that will take away my radiance!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسُمْنِي خَسِيْسَةً يَصْغُرُ لَهَا قَدْرِي، وَلاَ نَقِيصَةً يُجْهَلُ مِنْ أَجْلِهَا مَكَانِي،
records.transliteration: wa lā tasumnī khasīsatayn yaṣghuru lahā qadri wa lā naqīṣatan yujhalu min ajlihā makānī
records.english_text: Visit me not with a meanness that will diminish my worth or a deficiency that will keep my rank unknown!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرُعْنِي رَوْعَةً أُبْلِسُ بِها، وَلاَ خِيْفةً أوجِسُ دُونَهَا.
records.transliteration: walā taruʿnī rawʿatan ʾublisu bihā, walā khiyfatan awjisu dūnahā
records.english_text: Frighten me not with a fright by which I will despair or a terror through which I will dread,

records.arabic_text: اجْعَلْ هَيْبَتِي في وَعِيدِكَ، وَحَذَرِي مِنْ إعْذارِكَ وَإنْذَارِكَ، وَرَهْبَتِي عِنْدَ تِلاَوَةِ آياتِكَ،
records.transliteration: ijʿal haybatī fī waʿīdika waḥaḏari min iʿḏārika wa-inḏārika wa rahbatī ʿinda tilāwat āyātika
records.english_text: but make me stand in awe of Thy threat, take precautions against Thy leaving no excuses and Thy warning, and tremble at the recitation of Thy verses!

records.arabic_text: وَاعْمُرْ لَيْلِي بِإيقَاظِي فِيهِ لِعِبَادَتِكَ، وَتَفَرُّدِي بِالتَّهَجُّدِ لَكَ، وَتَجَرُّدِي بِسُكُونِي إلَيْكَ، وَإنْزَالِ حَوَائِجِي بِكَ، وَمُنَازَلَتِي إيَّاكَ فِي فَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِي مِنْ نَارِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa aʿmur layli bi-iqāqī fīhi li-ʿibādatika wa tafarrudi bi-ttahajjudi laka, wa tajarrudi bi-sukooni ilayk wa inzāli ḥawāʾijī bika wa munāzalatī iyyāka fī fakāki raqabatī min nārika
records.english_text: Fill my night with life by keeping me awake therein for worshipping Thee, solitude with vigil for Thee, exclusive devotion to reliance upon Thee, setting my needs before Thee, and imploring that Thou wilt set my neck free from the Fire

records.arabic_text: وَإجَارَتِي مِمَّا فِيهِ أَهْلُهَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa-ijāratī mimmā fīhi ahluhā min ʿathābika
records.english_text: and grant me sanctuary from Thy chastisement, within which its inhabitants dwell!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَذَرْنِي فِي طُغْيَانِي عَامِهاً، وَلاَ فِي غَمْرَتِي سَاهِياً حَتَّى حِين، وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي عِظَةً لِمَنِ اتَّعَظَ، وَلاَ نَكَالاً لِمَنِ اعْتَبَرَ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةً لِمَن نَظَرَ، وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ بِيَ فِيمَنْ تَمْكُرُ بِهِ،
records.transliteration: walā taḏarnī fī ṭughyānī ʿāmihan walā fī ghamratī sāhīyan ḥattā ḥīn wala taj'alni 'izatan limani at'ta'atha, wa la naqalan limani 'etabar wa lā fitnatan liman naẓara, wa lā tamkur biya fīman tamkuruhu
records.english_text: Leave me not blindly wandering in my insolence or inattentive in my perplexity for a time, make me not an admonition to him who takes admonishment, a punishment exemplary for him who takes heed, a trial for him who observes, devise not against me along with those against whom Thou devisest,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِيَ غَيْرِي، وَلاَ تُغَيِّرْ لِيْ إسْماً، وَلاَ تُبدِّلْ لِي جِسْماً، وَلاَ تَتَّخِذْنِي هُزُوَاً لِخَلْقِكَ، وَلاَ سُخْرِيّاً لَكَ، وَلاَ تَبَعاً إلاَّ لِمَرْضَاتِكَ، وَلاَ مُمْتَهَناً إلاَّ بِالانْتِقَامِ لَكَ، وَأَوْجِدْنِي بَرْدَ عَفْوِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā tastabdil biya ghayri, walā tughayyir li isman walā tubaddil lī jisman, walā tattakhidhnī huzūan li-khalqika wa lā sukhriyyan laka, wa lā tabaʿan illā li-marḍātika walā mumtahana illa bil-intiqāmi laka, wa awjidnī barda ʿafwik
records.english_text: replace me not with another, change not my name, transform not my body, appoint me not a mockery for Thy creatures, a laughing-stock for Thyself, a follower of anything but Thy good pleasure, a menial servant for anything but avenging Thee! Let me find the coolness of Thy pardon

records.arabic_text: و حَلاَوَةَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَرَوْحِكَ وَرَيْحَانِكَ وَجَنَّةِ نَعِيْمِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa ḥalāwata raḥmatika wa rūḥika wa rayḥānika wa jannati naʿīmika
records.english_text: and the sweetness of Thy mercy, Thy repose, Thy ease, and the garden of Thy bliss!

records.arabic_text: وَأَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْفَرَاغِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ بِسَعَة مِنْ سَعَتِكَ، وَالاجْتِهَادِ فِيمَا يُزْلِفُ لَدَيْكَ وَعِنْدَك، وَأَتْحِفْنِي بِتُحْفَة مِنْ تُحَفَاتِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa-ʾadhiqnee ṭaʿma al-faraagh limaa tuḥibbu bisaʿatin min saʿatika wa al-ijtihād fīmā yuzlifu ladayka wa ʿindaka wa'atḥifnī bi tuḥfatim min tuḥafātika
records.english_text: Let me taste, through some of Thy boundless plenty, the flavour of being free for what Thou lovest and striving in what brings about proximity with Thee and to Thee, and give me a gift from among Thy gifts!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ تِجَارَتِي رَابِحَةً، وَكَرَّتِي غَيْرَ خَاسِرَة، وَأَخِفْنِي مَقَامَكَ، وَشَوِّقْنِي لِقاءَكَ، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً لاَ تُبْقِ مَعَهَا ذُنُوباً صِغِيرَةً وَلا كَبِيرَةً، وَلاَ تَذَرْ مَعَهَا عَلاَنِيَةً وَلاَ سَرِيرَةً،
records.transliteration: waajʿal tijaarati raabihatan, wakarati ghayra khaasirah wa-akhifnī maqāmaka, wa-shawwiqnī liqā'aka wa tub ʿalayya tawbatan naṣūḥan lā tubqi maʿahā dhunūban ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan walā taẓar maʿahā ʿalāniyatun walā sariyratun
records.english_text: Make my commerce profitable and my return without loss, fill me with fear of Thy station, make me yearn for the meeting with Thee, and allow me to repent with an unswerving repentance along with which Thou lettest no sins remain, small or large, and leavest no wrongs, open or secret!

records.arabic_text: وَانْزَعِ الْغِلَّ مِنْ صَدْرِي لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاعْطِفْ بِقَلْبِي عَلَى الْخَاشِعِيْنَ، وَكُنْ لِي كَمَا تَكُونُ لِلصَّالِحِينَ، وَحَلِّنِي حِلْيَةَ الْمُتَّقِينَ،
records.transliteration: waanzaʿi al-ghilla min sadrii lilmuʾminin wa'atif biqalbi 'ala al-khashi'īn wa kun li kama takun li al-salihin wa hallinii hilyata al-muttaqeen
records.english_text: Root out rancour toward the faithful from my breast, bend my heart toward the humble, be toward me as Thou art toward the righteous, adorn me with the adornment of the godfearing,

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيَ لِسَانَ صِدْق فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَذِكْراً نامِياً فِي الاخِرِينَ، وَوَافِ بِيَ عَرْصَةَ الاَوَّلِينَ،
records.transliteration: wajʿal liya lisāna ṣidq fī al-ghābirīn wa dhikran nāmiyan fī al-ākhiriyna, wa wāfi biya arṣata al-awwalīna
records.english_text: appoint for me a goodly report among those yet to come and a growing remembrance among the later folk, and take me to the plain of those who came first!

records.arabic_text: وَتَمِّمْ سُبُوغَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَظَاهِرْ كَرَامَاتِهَا لَدَيَّ، و امْلاْ مِنْ فَوَائِدِكَ يَدَيَّ، وَسُقْ كَرَائِمَ مَوَاهِبِكَ إلَيَّ، وَجَاوِرْ بِيَ الاَطْيَبِينَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآئِكَ فِي الْجِنَاْنِ الَّتِي زَيَّنْتَهَا لاَِصْفِيآئِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa tamim subugh ni'matika 'alayya, wa thahir karamatihā ladayya wa amla min fawāʾidika yadayya, wa suq karāʾima mawāhibika ilayya wa jāwir biya al-aṭyabīna min awliyā'ika fi al-jināni allatī zayyanta-hā la-iṣfiyā'ika
records.english_text: Complete the lavishness of Thy favour upon me, clothe me in its repeated generosities, fill my hand with Thy benefits, drive Thy generous gifts to me, make me the neighbour of the best of Thy friends in the Gardens which Thou hast adorned for Thy chosen

records.arabic_text: وَجَلِّلْنِي شَرَآئِفَ نِحَلِكَ فِي الْمَقَامَاتِ الْمُعَدَّةِ لاَِحِبَّائِكَ،
records.transliteration: wajallilnī sharāʾifan niḥalika fī al-maqāmāt al-muʿaddati li-ahibbāʾik
records.english_text: and wrap me in Thy noble presents in the stations prepared for Thy beloveds!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيَ عِنْدَكَ مَقِيْلاً آوِي إلَيْهِ مُطْمَئِنّاً، وَمَثابَةً أَتَبَوَّأُهَا وَأَقَرُّ عَيْناً.
records.transliteration: wa-j'al liya ʿindaka maqīlan ʾāwi ilayhi muṭmaʾinnan wa mathābatan atabawwa'uha wa aqarru ʿaynan
records.english_text: Appoint for me a resting place with Thee where I may seek haven in serenity, and a resort to which I may revert and rest my eyes,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُقَايِسْنِي بِعَظِيمَاتِ الْجَرَائِرِ، وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ، وَأَزِلْ عَنِّي كُلَّ شَكٍّ وَشُبْهَة، وَاجْعَلْ لِي فِي الْحَقِّ طَرِيقاً مِنْ كُلِّ رَحْمَة،
records.transliteration: walā tuqāyisnī biʿaẓīmāt al-jarāʾir wa lā tuhliknī yawma tublā al-sarā'iru wa azil ʿanni kulla shakkin wa shubhah wa-jaʿal li fil-ḥaqqi ṭarīqan min kulli raḥmah
records.english_text: weigh not against me my dreadful misdeeds, destroy me not on "the day the secrets are tried" (86:9), eliminate from me every doubt and uncertainty, appoint for me a way in the truth from every mercy,

records.arabic_text: وأَجْزِلْ لِي قِسَمَ الْمَواهِبِ مِنْ نَوَالِكَ، وَوَفِّرْ عَلَيَّ حُظُوظَ الاِحْسَانِ مِنْ إفْضَالِكَ،
records.transliteration: wa ajzil li qisma al-mawahibi min nawalika wa waffir ʿalayya ḥuẓūẓa al-iḥsāni min ifḍālik
records.english_text: make plentiful for me the portions of gifts from Thy granting of awards, and fill out for me the shares of beneficence from Thy bestowal of bounty!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ قَلْبِي وَاثِقاً بِمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَهَمِّيَ مُسْتَفْرَغاً لِمَا هُوَ لَكَ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِما تَسْتَعْمِلُ بِهِ خَالِصَتَكَ، وَأَشْرِبْ قَلْبِي عِنْدَ ذُهُولِ العُقُولِ طَاعَتَكَ،
records.transliteration: wajʿal qalbī wāthiqan bimā ʿindak wa hammīya mustafraġan limā huwa laka wa astaʿmilnī bimā tastaʿmilu bihi khāliṣatika wa-ashrib qalbi 'indadhuwli-l-'uquul taa'atak
records.english_text: Make my heart trust in what is with Thee and my concern free for what is Thine, employ me in that in which Thou employest Thy pure friends, drench my heart with Thy obedience when intellects are distracted,

records.arabic_text: وَاجْمَعْ لِي الْغِنى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالدَّعَةَ، وَالْمُعَافَاةَ، وَالصِّحَّةَ، وَالسَّعَةَ، وَالطُّمَأْنِيْنَةَ، وَالْعَافِيَةَ،
records.transliteration: waajma' li al-ghinā, wal-'afāf, wadda'ah, wal-mu'āfāh wal-ṣiḥḥah, was-saʿah, waṭ-ṭumaniinah, wal-ʿaafiyah
records.english_text: and combine within me independence, continence, ease, release, health, plenty, tranquillity, and well being!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تُحْبِطْ حَسَنَاتِي بِمَا يَشُوبُهَا مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ، وَلاَ خَلَواتِي بِمَا يَعْرِضُ لِيَ مِنْ نَزَغَاتِ فِتْنَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: walā tuḥbiṭ ḥasanātī bimā yashūbuha min maʿṣiyatika walā khalawātī bimā yaʿriḍu liya min nazaghāti fitnatika
records.english_text: Make not fail my good deeds through my disobedience that stains them or my private times of worship through the instigations of Thy trial!

records.arabic_text: وَصُنْ وَجْهِي عَنِ الطَّلَبِ إلَى أَحَد مِنَ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَذُبَّنِي عَنِ التِماسِ مَا عِنْدَ الفَاسِقِينَ،
records.transliteration: waṣun wajhī ʿani aṭ-ṭalabi ilá ʾaḥad min al-ʿālamīn wa thubbanī ʿani atimāsi mā ʿinda al-fāsiqīn
records.english_text: Safeguard my face from asking from anyone in the world, and drive me far from begging for that which is with the ungodly!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي لِلظَّالِمِينَ ظَهِيراً، وَلاَ لَهُمْ عَلى مَحْوِ كِتَابِكَ يَداً وَنَصِيراً،
records.transliteration: walā tajʿalnī liẓ-ẓālimīna ẓahīran walā lahūm ʿalā maḥwī kitābika yadān wa naṣīrā
records.english_text: Make me not an aid to the wrongdoers, nor their hand and helper in erasing Thy Book!

records.arabic_text: وَحُطْنِي مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ حِيَاطَةً تَقِيْنِي بِهَا،
records.transliteration: waḥuṭnī min ḥaythu lā aʿlamu ḥiyāṭatan taqīnī bihā
records.english_text: Defend me whence I know not with a defense through which Thou protectest me!

records.arabic_text: وَافْتَحْ لِيَ أَبْوَابَ تَوْبَتِكَ وَرَحْمَتِكَ وَرَأْفَتِكَ وَرِزْقِكَ الواسِعِ،
records.transliteration: wa-iftaḥ liya abwāba tawbatika wa raḥmatika wa raʾfatika wa rizqika al-wāsiʿi
records.english_text: Open toward me the gates of Thy repentance, Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and Thy boundless provision!

records.arabic_text: إنِّي إلَيْكَ مِنَ الرَّاغِبِينَ،
records.transliteration: ʾinnī ʾilayka mina al-rāghibīn
records.english_text: Surely I am one of those who beseech Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَأَتْمِمْ لِي إنْعَامَكَ، إنَّكَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْعِمِيْنَ،
records.transliteration: wa'tmim li inʿāmak, innaka khayru almunʿimīn
records.english_text: And complete Thy favour toward me! Surely Thou art the best of those who show favour!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ باقِيَ عُمْرِيْ فِي الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ ابْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِكَ يَاربَّ الْعَالَمِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa-jʿal bāqiya ʿumrī fī al-ḥajj wa-al-ʿumrah ibtighāʾa wajhika yā rabba al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: Place the rest of my life in the hajj and the 'umra seeking Thy face, O Lord of the worlds!

records.arabic_text: وَصَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الطَّاهِرِينَ، وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَبَدَ الابِدِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa ṣalla allāhu ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi al-ṭṭayyibīna al-ṭāhirīn wa al-salāmu ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim abada al-abidiin
records.english_text: And may God bless Muhammad and his Household, the good, the pure, and peace be upon him and them always and forever!

readings.title: 48. His Supplication on the Day of Sacrifice and on Friday
readings.arabicTitle: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي يَوْمِ الْأَضْحَى وَ الْجُمُعَةِ
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ مُبَارَكٌ مَيْمُونٌ وَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ فِيهِ مُجْتَمِعُونَ فِي أَقْطَارِ أَرْضِكَ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma hādhā yawmun mubārakun maymūnun wa al-muslimūna fīhi mujtamiʿūna fī aqṭāri arḍika
records.english_text: O God, this is a blessed and fortunate day, within which the Muslims are gathered in the quarters of Thy earth.

records.arabic_text: يَشْهَدُ السَّائِلُ مِنْهُمْ وَ الطَّالِبُ وَ الرَّاغِبُ وَ الرَّاهِبُ وَ أَنْتَ النَّاظِرُ فِي حَوَائِجِهِمْ
records.transliteration: yashhadu al-sā'ilu minhum wa al-ṭālibu wa al-rāghibu wa al-rāhibu wa anta alnāẓiru fī ḥawāʾijihim
records.english_text: Among them are present the asker, the seeker, the beseecher, the fearful, while Thou art looking upon their needs.

records.arabic_text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ وَ هَوَانِ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ عَلَيْكَ
records.transliteration: fa-as'aluka bi-joodika wa karamika wa hawani ma sa'alutaka 'alayk
records.english_text: So I ask Thee by Thy munificence and generosity and easy upon Thee is what I ask Thee!

records.arabic_text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ الْحَنَّانُ الْمَنَّانُ ذُو الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ،
records.transliteration: an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi wa as'aluka allahumma rabbana bi-anna laka al-mulka wa laka al-hamda lā ilāha illā anta, al-ḥalīmu al-karīmu al-ḥannānu al-mannānu dhū al-jalāl wa al-ikrām, badīʿu al-samāwāt wa al-ʾarḍ
records.english_text: - that Thou blessest Muhammad and his Household And I ask Thee, O God, our Lord -for Thine is the kingdom and Thine is the praise there is no god but Thou,the Clement, the Generous,the All-loving, the All-kind, Possessor of majesty and munificence,Originator of the heavens and the earth

records.arabic_text: ، مَهْمَا قَسَمْتَ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ أَوْ عَافِيَةٍ أَوْ بَرَكَةٍ أَوْ هُدًى أَوْ عَمَلٍ بِطَاعَتِكَ ،أَوْ خَيْرٍ تَمُنُّ بِهِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَهْدِيهِمْ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ أَوْ تَرْفَعُ لَهُمْ عِنْدَكَ دَرَجَةً
records.transliteration: , ma hm a qasamta bayna ʿib a dik al-muʾminin min khayrin aw ʿāfiyah aw barakah aw hudan aw ʿamalin bi-ṭāʿatika 'aw khayrin tamunnu bihi 'alayhim tahdiyhim bihi 'ilayka aw tarfaʿu lahum ʿindaka darajah
records.english_text: whenever Thou apportionest among Thy faithful servants good, well being, blessing, guidance, works in obedience to Thee, or good through which Thou art kind to them by guiding them to Thee, or raisest them up a degree with Thee,

records.arabic_text: ، أَوْ تُعْطِيهِمْ بِهِ خَيْراً مِنْ خَيْرِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ .أَنْ تُوَفِّرَ حَظِّي وَ نَصِيبِي مِنْهُ
records.transliteration: , ʾaw tuʿṭīhim bihi khayran min khayri al-dunyā wa al-ākhirah ʾan tuwaffira ḥazẓī wa naṣībī minhu
records.english_text: or givest them the good of this world or the next, that Thou givest me amply my share and allotment of it.

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِأَنَّ ,لَكَ الْمُلْكَ وَ الْحَمْدَ
records.transliteration: wa as'aluka allahumma bi-anna.. laka al-mulk wa al-hamd
records.english_text: And I ask Thee, O God - for Thine is the kingdom and the praise;

records.arabic_text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَ رَسُولِكَ وَ حَبِيبِكَ وَ صِفْوَتِكَ
records.transliteration: lā ʾilāha ʾillā anta an tuṣalliya ʿalā muḥammadin ʿabdika wa rasulika wa ḥabībika wa ṣifwatika
records.english_text: there is no god but Thou - that Thou blessest Muhammad Thy servant and Thy messenger, Thy beloved and Thy selected friend,

records.arabic_text: ,وَ خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ عَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْأَبْرَارِ الطَّاهِرِينَ الْأَخْيَارِ ,صَلَاةً لَا يَقْوَى عَلَى إِحْصَائِهَا إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَ أَنْ تُشْرِكَنَا فِي
records.transliteration: wa khayrati-ka min khalqi-ka wa ʿalā āli muḥammad al-abrār al-ṭāhirīn al-akhyār ṣalātan lā yaqwā ʿalā iḥṣāʾihā illā anta wa an tushrikana fi
records.english_text: Thy chosen from among Thy creation, and the Household of Muhammad, the pious, the pure, the chosen, with a blessing no one has strength to count but Thou, that Thou associatest us with

records.arabic_text: صَالِحِ مَنْ دَعَاكَ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ،يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ ,وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا وَ لَهُمْ
records.transliteration: ṣāliḥi man daʿāka fī hādhā al-yawm min ʿibādika al-muʾminīn yā rabba al-ʿālamīn wa an taghfira lana wa lahum
records.english_text: the most righteous of those who supplicate Thee today of Thy faithful servants - O Lord of the worlds!— and that Thou forgivest us and them!

records.arabic_text: .إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ قَدِيرٌ
records.transliteration: ʾinnaka ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
records.english_text: "Surely Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26).

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ تَعَمَّدْتُ بِحَاجَتِي وَ بِكَ أَنْزَلْتُ الْيَوْمَ فَقْرِي ،وَ فَاقَتِي وَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَ إِنِّي بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ وَ رَحْمَتِكَ أَوْثَقُ مِنِّي بِعَمَلِي
records.transliteration: allahumma ilayka taʿammadtu bihajati wa bika anzaltu al-yawma faqri wa faqatī wa maskanatī wa inni bimaghfiratika wa rahmatika awthaqu minni biamali
records.english_text: O God, toward Thee I aim with my need and before Thee today I set my poverty, my neediness, my misery, for I have more trust in Thy forgiveness and Thy mercy than in my own works.

records.arabic_text: وَ لَمَغْفِرَتُكَ وَ رَحْمَتُكَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي
records.transliteration: wa lamaghfiratuka wa rahmatuka awsau min dhunubi
records.english_text: Thy forgiveness and Thy mercy are vaster than my sins.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ ، وَ تَوَلَّ قَضَاءَ كُلِّ حَاجَةٍ هِيَ لِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهَا ، وَ تَيْسِيرِ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْكَ
records.transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa tawalla qadha'a kulli hajah hiya li bi-qudratika 'alayha , wa taysīri dhālika ʿalayka
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and attend to the accomplishment of every need of mine through Thy power over it, its easiness for Thee,

records.arabic_text: وَ بِفَقْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَ غِنَاكَ عَنِّي
records.transliteration: wa bi-faqri ilayka wa ghināka ʿannī
records.english_text: my poverty toward Thee, and Thy freedom from need for me!

records.arabic_text: ، فَإِنِّي لَمْ أُصِبْ خَيْراً قَطُّ إِلَّا مِنْكَ ، وَ لَمْ يَصْرِفْ عَنِّي سُوءاً قَطُّ أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ وَ لَا أَرْجُو لِأَمْرِ آخِرَتِي وَ دُنْيَايَ سِوَاكَ
records.transliteration: fa'inni lam usib khayran qattu illa minka wa lam yasrif ʿanni suʾan qattu aḥadun ghayruka wa lā arjū li-amri ākhiratī wa dunyāyā siwāka
records.english_text: I will come upon no good whatsoever unless through Thee, no one other than Thou will turn any evil away from me, and I have hope in none but Thee for my affair in the next world and in this world.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ تَهَيَّأَ وَ تَعَبَّأَ وَ أَعَدَّ وَ اسْتَعَدَّ لِوِفَادَةٍ إِلَى مَخْلُوقٍ رَجَاءَ رِفْدِهِ وَ نَوَافِلِهِ وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِهِ وَ جَائِزَتِهِ
records.transliteration: allāhumma man tahayyā' wa ta'abbā'ah wa aʿadda wa istaʿadda li-wifādatin ilā makhluqin rajā'a rifdihī wa nawāfilihī wa ṭalaba naylihī wa jā'izatihī
records.english_text: O God, if anyone has ever arranged, made ready, prepared, and drawn himself up to be received by a creature in hope of his support and awards,

records.arabic_text: فَإِلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلَايَ كَانَتِ الْيَوْمَ تَهْيِئَتِي وَ تَعْبِئَتِي وَ إِعْدَادِي وَ اسْتِعْدَادِي رَجَاءَ عَفْوِكَ وَ رِفْدِكَ
records.transliteration: fa'ilayka ya mawlaya kānatil yawma tahyiʾatī wa taʿbiʾatī wa-iʿdādī wa-istiʿdādī rajāʾa ʿafwik(a) wa rifdik(a)
records.english_text: then today toward Thee, my Master, is my arrangement, my making ready, my preparation, and my drawing up in hope of Thy pardon and support

records.arabic_text: وَ طَلَبَ نَيْلِكَ وَ جَائِزَتِكَ
records.transliteration: wa ṭalaba naylika wa jā'izatika
records.english_text: and in seeking to attain to Thee and Thy prize.

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَا تُخَيِّبِ الْيَوْمَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَجَائِي،
records.transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa lā tukhayyibi al-yawma dhālika min rajā'ī
records.english_text: O God, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and disappoint not my hope in that today!

records.arabic_text: يَا مَنْ لَا يُحْفِيهِ سَائِلٌ وَ لَا يَنْقُصُهُ نَائِلٌ
records.transliteration: yā man lā yuḥfīhī sāʾilun wa lā yanqusuhu nā'ilun
records.english_text: O He who is not troubled by those who ask and diminished by those who attain their desire!

records.arabic_text: فَإِنِّي لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً مِنِّي بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ قَدَّمْتُهُ وَ لَا شَفَاعَةِ مَخْلُوقٍ رَجَوْتُهُ إِلَّا شَفَاعَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
records.transliteration: fa'inni lam atika thiqahtan minnee bi'amalin saalihin qaddamtu-hu walā shafāʿati makhlooqin rajawtuhu illā shafāʿata muḥammadin wa ahl baytih
records.english_text: I come not before Thee trusting in a righteous work I have sent ahead, nor in the intercession of any creature in whom I have hope, except the intercession of Muhammad and the Folk of his House

records.arabic_text: عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَلَامُكَ
records.transliteration: ʿalayhi wa ʿalayhim salāmuka
records.english_text: (upon him and upon them be Thy peace).

records.arabic_text: أَتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً بِالْجُرْمِ وَ الْإِسَاءَةِ إِلَى نَفْسِي
records.transliteration: ataytuka muqirran biljurm wal'isaaiati ilaa nafsi
records.english_text: I come to Thee admitting sin and evildoing toward myself.

records.arabic_text: أَتَيْتُكَ أَرْجُو عَظِيمَ عَفْوِكَ الَّذِي عَفَوْتَ بِهِ عَنِ الْخَاطِئِينَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلَى عَظِيمِ الْجُرْمِ أَنْ عُدْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ
records.transliteration: ataytuka arjuu `aẓeema `afwik alla th ee ʿafawta bihi ʿani al-khāṭiʾīn thumma lam yamnaʿka ṭūlu ʿukūfihim ʿalā ʿaẓīmil jurm 'an 'udta 'alayhim biraḥmati wal-maghfirah
records.english_text: I come to Thee hoping for Thy abounding pardon through which Thou hast pardoned the offenders, while their long persistence in dreadful sin did not prevent Thee from returning toward them with mercy and forgiveness!

records.arabic_text: فَيَا مَنْ رَحْمَتُهُ وَاسِعَةٌ وَ عَفْوُهُ عَظِيمٌ
records.transliteration: fayā man raḥmatuhu wāsiʿah wa ʿafwuhu ʿaẓīm
records.english_text: O He whose mercy is wide and whose pardon is abounding!

records.arabic_text: ، يَا عَظِيمُ يَا عَظِيمُ
records.transliteration: yā ʿaẓīmu, yā ʿaẓīmu
records.english_text: O All-mighty! O All-mighty!

records.arabic_text: يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ
records.transliteration: yā karīmu, yā karīmu
records.english_text: O All-generous! O All-generous!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عُدْ عَلَيَّ بِرَحْمَتِكَ وَ تَعَطَّفْ عَلَيَّ بِفَضْلِكَ وَ تَوَسَّعْ عَلَيَّ بِمَغْفِرَتِكَ
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin. wa ʿud ʿalayya biraḥmatika wa taʿattaf ʿalayya bifadlika wa tawassal ʿalayya bimaghfiratika
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, return toward me through Thy mercy, be tender toward me through Thy bounty, and spread out Thy forgiveness upon me!

records.arabic_text: . اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا الْمَقَامَ لِخُلَفَائِكَ وَ أَصْفِيَائِكَ وَ مَوَاضِعَ أُمَنَائِكَ فِي الدَّرَجَةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ الَّتِي اخْتَصَصْتَهُمْ بِهَا قَدِ ابْتَزُّوهَا
records.transliteration: allāhumma innahā al-maqāma li-khulafā'ika wa asfiyā'ika wa mawāḍiʿa ʾumanāʾika fī al-darajah al-rafīʿah allatī ikhtashaṣtahum bihā qadi ibtazzuha
records.english_text: O God, this station belongs to Thy vicegerents, Thy chosen, while the places of Thy trusted ones in the elevated degree which Thou hast singled out for them have been forcibly stripped!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّرُ لِذَلِكَ لَا يُغَالَبُ أَمْرُكَ وَ لَا يُجَاوَزُ الْمَحْتُومُ مِنْ تَدْبِيرِكَ
records.transliteration: wa anta almuqaddiru lidthalik lā yughālabu amruka wa laa yujāwizu al-mahtūmu min tadbīrika
records.english_text: But Thou art the Ordainer of that - Thy command is not overcome, the inevitable in Thy governing is not overstepped!

records.arabic_text: كَيْفَ شِئْتَ وَ أَنَّى شِئْتَ
records.transliteration: kayfa shi'ta wa anna shi'ta
records.english_text: However Thou willest and whenever Thou willest!

records.arabic_text: وَ لِمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ غَيْرُ مُتَّهَمٍ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ وَ لَا لِإِرَادَتِكَ
records.transliteration: wa lima anta a'lamu bihi ghayru muttahamin ʿala khalqik wa la li-iradatik
records.english_text: In that which Thou knowest best, Thou art not accused for Thy creation or Thy will!

records.arabic_text: حَتَّى عَادَ صِفْوَتُكَ وَ خُلَفَاؤُكَ مَغْلُوبِينَ مَقْهُورِينَ مُبْتَزِّينَ
records.transliteration: ḥattá ʿāda ṣifwatuka wa khulafāʾuka maghloobiy-na maqhoo-ree-na mubtaz-zeen-a
records.english_text: Then Thy selected friends, Thy vicegerents, were overcome, vanquished, forcibly stripped;

records.arabic_text: يَرَوْنَ حُكْمَكَ مُبَدَّلًا وَ كِتَابَكَ مَنْبُوذاً ، وَ فَرَائِضَكَ مُحَرَّفَةً عَنْ جِهَاتِ أَشْرَاعِكَ وَ سُنَنَ نَبِيِّكَ مَتْرُوكَةً
records.transliteration: yarawn ḥukmaka mubaddalan wa kitābaka manbūẓan wa fara'idaka muḥarrafaṭan ʿan jihāti ash-rāʿik wa sunna nabiyika matruukah
records.english_text: they see Thy decree replaced, Thy Book discarded, Thy obligations distorted from the aims of Thy laws, and the Sunna of Thy Prophet abandoned!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْ أَعْدَاءَهُمْ مِنَ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَ الْآخِرِينَ وَ مَنْ رَضِيَ بِفِعَالِهِمْ وَ أَشْيَاعَهُمْ وَ أَتْبَاعَهُمْ
records.transliteration: allāhumma al-ʿan ʾaʿdāʾahum min al-ʾawwalīna wa al-ʾākhirīn wa man raḍiya bifiaʿalihim wa ashyaʾahum wa atbaʿahum
records.english_text: O God, curse their enemies among those of old and the later folk, and all those pleased with their acts, and their adherents and followers!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ كَصَلَوَاتِكَ وَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَ تَحِيَّاتِكَ عَلَى أَصْفِيَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin ʾinnaka ḥamīdun majīdun ka ṣalāwatika wa barakātika wa taḥiyyātik ʿalā ʾaṣfīyāʾika ibrāhīma wa āli ibrāhīma
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad (surely Thou art All-laudable, All-glorious) like Thy blessing, benedictions, and salutations upon Thy chosen Abraham and the people of Abraham!

records.arabic_text: وَ عَجِّلِ الْفَرَجَ وَ الرَّوْحَ وَ النُّصْرَةَ وَ التَّمْكِينَ وَ التَّأْيِيدَ لَهُمْ
records.transliteration: wa ʿajjil al-faraj wa ar-roḥa wa an-nuṣrata wa at-tamkīna wa at-ta'yyīda lahum
records.english_text: And hasten for them relief, ease, help, strengthening,and confirmation!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَهْلِ التَّوْحِيدِ وَ الْإِيمَانِ بِكَ وَ التَّصْدِيقِ بِرَسُولِكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma wajʿalnī.. min ahlī ʾattawḥīd wa al-īmāni bika wa at-taṣdīqi bi rasūlika
records.english_text: O God, and make me one of the people who profess Thy Unity, have faith in Thee, and attest to Thy Messenger

records.arabic_text: وَ الْأَئِمَّةِ الَّذِينَ حَتَمْتَ طَاعَتَهُمْ مِمَّنْ يَجْرِي ذَلِكَ بِهِ وَ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ
records.transliteration: wa al-a'immati alladhina hattamta ta'atahum mimman yajrī dhalika bihi wa ʿalá yadayhi
records.english_text: and the Imams toward whom Thou hast enjoined obedience, and one of those through whom and at whose hands this takes place!

records.arabic_text: آمِينَ رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ
records.transliteration: ʾāmīn rabbi al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: Amen, Lord of the worlds!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ لَيْسَ يَرُدُّ غَضَبَكَ إِلَّا حِلْمُكَ ، وَ لَا يَرُدُّ سَخَطَكَ إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ وَ لا يُجِيرُ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَتُكَ وَ لَا يُنْجِينِي مِنْكَ
records.transliteration: allāhumma laysa yaruddu ghaḍabaka illā ḥilmuka , wa lā yaruddu sakhatuka illā 'afwuka wa lā yujīru min ʿiqābika illā raḥmatuka wa lā yunjinī minka
records.english_text: O God, nothing repels Thy wrath but Thy clemency, nothing repels Thy displeasure but Thy pardon, nothing grants sanctuary from Thy punishment but Thy mercy, and nothing will deliver me from Thee

records.arabic_text: إِلَّا التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ هَبْ لَنَا يَا إِلَهِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ فَرَجاً بِالْقُدْرَةِالَّتِي بِهَا تُحْيِي أَمْوَاتَ الْعِبَادِ
records.transliteration: illā at-taḍarruʿu ʾilayka wa bayna yadayka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa hab lana ya ilahi min ladunka farajan bi al-qudrah al-lati biha tuhyi amwat al-'ibad
records.english_text: except pleading to Thee before Thee, so bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and give us on Thy part, my God, relief by means of the power through which Thou bringest the dead servants to life

records.arabic_text: وَ بِهَا تَنْشُرُ مَيْتَ الْبِلَادِ
records.transliteration: wa bihā tanshuru maytal bilād
records.english_text: and revivest the dead lands.

records.arabic_text: . وَ لَا تُهْلِكْنِي يَا إِلَهِي غَمّاً حَتَّى تَسْتَجِيبَ لِي وَ تُعَرِّفَنِي الْإِجَابَةَ فِي دُعَائِي
records.transliteration: wa lā tuhliknī yā ilāhī ghamman ḥattā tastajība lī wa tuʿarrafanī al-ijābata fī duʿāʾī
records.english_text: Destroy me not through gloom, my God, before Thou respondest to me and givest me the knowledge of Thy response to my supplication!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي
records.transliteration: wa adhqnī ṭaʿmal-ʿāfiya ilā muntaḥā ajalī
records.english_text: Let me taste the flavour of well-being to the end of my term!

records.arabic_text: وَ لَا تُشْمِتْ بِي عَدُوِّي وَ لَا تُمَكِّنْهُ مِنْ عُنُقِي وَ لَا تُسَلِّطْهُ عَلَيَّ
records.transliteration: wa lā tushmit biy ʿaduwwi wa lā tumakkinnhu min ʿunuqī wa lā tusallithu ʿalayya
records.english_text: And let not my enemy gloat over me, place not my neck in his power, and give him not authority over me!

records.arabic_text: إِلَهِي إِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَضَعُنِي
records.transliteration: ilāhī in rafaʿtanī faman dhā al-ladhī yaḍaʿunī
records.english_text: My God, if Thou raisest me up, who is there to push me down?

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي
records.transliteration: wa in wadaʿtanī faman dha alladhi yarfa`uni
records.english_text: If Thou pushest me down, who is there to raise me up?

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَكْرَمْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُهِينُنِي
records.transliteration: wa in akramtani faman dhā alladhī yuhīnunī
records.english_text: If Thou honourest me, who is there to humiliate me?

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَهَنْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يُكْرِمُنِي
records.transliteration: wa in ahantanī faman dhā alladhī yukrimunī
records.english_text: If Thou humiliatest me, who is there to honour me?

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنْ عَذَّبْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْحَمُنِي
records.transliteration: wa in ʿaẓẓabtanī faman dhā alladhī yarhamunī
records.english_text: If Thou chastisest me, who is there to have mercy upon me?

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنْ أَهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ أَوْ يَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ أَمْرِهِ
records.transliteration: wa in ahlaktani man dhā alladhī yaʿriḍu laka fī ʿabdika? ʾaw yasʾalu-ka ʿan ʾamri-hi
records.english_text: If Thou destroyest me, who is there to stand up for Thy servant against Thee or ask Thee about his affair?

records.arabic_text: وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ وَ لَا فِي نَقِمَتِكَ عَجَلَةٌ
records.transliteration: wa qad 'alimtu annahu laysa fi hukmika dhulm wa lā fī naqimati-ka ʿajalah
records.english_text: But I know that there is no wrong in Thy decree and no hurry in Thy vengeance.

records.arabic_text: وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُّلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ
records.transliteration: wa innama yaʿjalu man yakhafu al-fawt wa inna ma yah'taju ila al-thulmi al-dha'if
records.english_text: He alone hurries who fears to miss, and only the weak needs to wrong.

records.arabic_text: وَ قَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلَهِي عَنْ ذَلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
records.transliteration: wa qad taʿālayta yā ilāhī ʿan dhalika ʿuluwwan kabeeran
records.english_text: But Thou art exalted, my God, high indeed above all that!

records.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ لَا تَجْعَلْنِي لِلْبَلَاءِ غَرَضاً ، وَ لَا لِنَقِمَتِكَ نَصَباً وَ مَهِّلْنِي، وَ نَفِّسْنِي
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin wa lā tajʿalnī lil-balāʾi gharadhan wa lā li-naqimati-ka naṣaban wa mahhilnī, wa naffisnī
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, make me not the target of affliction nor the object of Thy vengeance, respite me, comfort me,

records.arabic_text: وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثْرَتِي وَ لَا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِبَلَاءٍ عَلَى أَثَرِ بَلَاءٍ فَقَدْ تَرَى ضَعْفِي
records.transliteration: wa aqilni ʿathrati wa lā tabtalīnī bi-balā'in ʿalā athari balāʾin fa qad tarā ḍaʿfī
