records.english_text: release me from my stumble, and afflict me not with an affliction in the wake of an affliction, for Thou hast seen my frailty,

records.arabic_text: وَ قِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي وَ تَضَرُّعِي إِلَيْكَ
records.transliteration: wa qillata ḥīlatī wa taḍarruʿī ilayka
records.english_text: the paucity of my stratagems, and my pleading to Thee!

records.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَ اللَّهُمَّ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِذْنِي.
records.transliteration: 'a'ūdhu bi-ka allāhumma al-yawma min ghaḍabika faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa aʿiẓnī
records.english_text: I seek refuge in Thee today, my God, from Thy wrath, so bless Muhammad and his Household and give me refuge!

records.arabic_text: ، وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَجِرْنِي
records.transliteration: wa astajīru bika al-yawma min sakhatika fasalli 'ala muhammadin wa alihi wa ajirni
records.english_text: I seek sanctuary in Thee today from Thy displeasure, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me sanctuary!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْأَلُكَ أَمْناً مِنْ عَذَابِكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ آمِنِّي
records.transliteration: wa as'aluka amnan min adhabika faṣallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih, wa āminnī
records.english_text: I ask Thee security from Thy chastisement, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and give me security!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَهْدِيكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اهْدِنِي
records.transliteration: wa astahdīka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa ahdinī
records.english_text: I seek guidance from Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَنْصِرُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ انْصُرْنِي
records.transliteration: wa astansiruka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih, wa anṣurni.
records.english_text: I seek help from Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and help me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَرْحِمُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْحَمْنِي
records.transliteration: wa astarhimuka fa salli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih, wa rḥamnī
records.english_text: I ask Thee for mercy, so bless Muhammad and his Household and have mercy upon me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَكْفِيكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اكْفِنِي
records.transliteration: wa astakfīka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi, wa ikfinī
records.english_text: I seek sufficiency from Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and suffice me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَرْزِقُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ ارْزُقْنِي
records.transliteration: wa astarziquka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih, wa arzuqnī
records.english_text: I seek provision from Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and provide for me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَعِينُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَعِنِّي
records.transliteration: wa astaʿeenuka faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī wa aʿinnī
records.english_text: I seek assistance from Thee, so bless Muhammad and his Household and assist me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اغْفِرْ لِي
records.transliteration: wa astaghfiruka lima salafa min dhunubi faṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih, wa ʾighfir lī
records.english_text: I pray forgiveness for my past sins, so bless Muhammad and his Household and forgive me!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَسْتَعْصِمُكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ، وَ اعْصِمْنِي فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَعُودَ لِشَيْ‏ءٍ كَرِهْتَهُ مِنِّي إِنْ شِئْتَ ذَلِكَ
records.transliteration: wa astaʿsimuka fasalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih, wa iʿsimnī fa inni lan aʿūda li shay'in kariḥtahu minni in shi'thādhika
records.english_text: I ask Thee to preserve me from sin, so bless Muhammad and his Household and preserve me, for I will not return to anything Thou dislikest from me, if Thou willest that!

records.arabic_text: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبِّ، يَا حَنَّانُ يَا مَنَّانُ
records.transliteration: yā rabbi yā rabbi, yā ḥannānu yā mannān
records.english_text: My Lord! My Lord! O All-loving! O All-kind!

records.arabic_text: يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَ الْإِكْرَامِ
records.transliteration: yā dhā al-jalāli wa al-ikrām
records.english_text: O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

records.arabic_text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اسْتَجِبْ لِي جَمِيعَ مَا سَأَلْتُكَ وَ طَلَبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَ رَغِبْتُ فِيهِ إِلَيْكَ
records.transliteration: ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālih wa-stajib li jamiʿa ma saaltuka wa talabtu ilayka wa raghibtu fiihi ilayka
records.english_text: Bless Muhammad and his Household, and grant me everything that I ask from Thee, seek from Thee, and beseech from Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَ أَرِدْهُ وَ قَدِّرْهُ وَ اقْضِهِ وَ أَمْضِهِ
records.transliteration: wa aridhu wa qaddirhu wa qdhih wa amdih
records.english_text: Will it, ordain it, decree it, and accomplish it!

records.arabic_text: وَ خِرْ لِي فِيمَا تَقْضِي مِنْه
records.transliteration: wa khir li fi ma taqdi minhu
records.english_text: Give me good in that of it which Thou decreest!

records.arabic_text: وَ بَارِكْ لِي فِي ذَلِكَ وَ تَفَضَّلْ عَلَيَّ بِهِ وَ أَسْعِدْنِي بِمَا تُعْطِينِي مِنْهُ وَ زِدْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
records.transliteration: wa bārik lī fī dhālika wa tafadhdhal 'alayya bihi wa asʿidnī bimā tuʿṭīnī minhu wa zidni min fadlika
records.english_text: Bless me in that, be gratuitously bountiful toward me through it, make me happy in that of it which Thou givest to me, and increase me in Thy bounty

records.arabic_text: وَ سَعَةِ مَا عِنْدَكَ فَإِنَّكَ وَاسِعٌ كَرِيمٌ
records.transliteration: wa saʿati mā ʿindaka fa-innaka waasiʿun kareemun
records.english_text: and the plenty of what is with Thee, for Thou art Boundless, Generous!

records.arabic_text: وَ صِلْ ذَلِكَ بِخَيْرِ الْآخِرَةِ وَ نَعِيمِهَا يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
records.transliteration: wa ṣil dhālika bi-khayr al-ākhira wa naʿīmihā yā ar-ḥama ar-rāḥimīn
records.english_text: And link that to the good and the bliss of the next world, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

records.arabic_text: تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ، وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ
records.transliteration: tadʿū bimā badā laka, wa tuṣallī ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihī alfa marrahā kadhā kāna yaf
records.english_text: Then you supplicate as seems proper to you and you call down blessings on Muhammed and his Household one thousand times. this is what he used to do (upon him be peace).
